campaign.name: AI WhatsApp first-reply automation for real-estate developers (Gujarat)
campaign.offer: WhatsApp automation: every enquiry gets a first reply in about a minute (brochure, 3 quick questions, site-visit slot) and one list for the sales team
campaign.need: Real-estate developers and brokers pay for enquiries that arrive on WhatsApp or by phone and lose buyers because nobody replies fast, especially in the evening and at night
campaign.buyer: Small and mid-size local developers and project brokers (owner or sales head decides)
campaign.geo: Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar, Surat, Vadodara, Rajkot and other Gujarat towns

chain.signal_observed: Runs Meta ads with a WhatsApp button for new Ahmedabad launches

fake.signal_observed: Running 6 Facebook ads with a Send WhatsApp message button since 12 Oct 2026 for its Zorbal Heights project in Bopal
fake.why_need: Enquiries only on WhatsApp, no instant reply

scrape.campaign: AI WhatsApp first-reply automation for real-estate developers (Gujarat)
scrape.need: Real-estate developers and brokers pay for enquiries that arrive on WhatsApp or by phone and lose buyers because nobody replies fast, especially in the evening and at night

need_analysis.summary: Real-estate developers and project brokers in Gujarat pay to get buyer enquiries (Meta/Google ads, portals, hoardings, launches) that land on WhatsApp or phone, but a small team answers slowly, so evening and night enquiries go cold. The need is a visible mix of three things: they spend on enquiries now, enquiries arrive by WhatsApp/phone, and the reply depends on people (staff hired to call, no instant reply).
need_analysis.who_has_this_need: Small and mid-size LOCAL developers (1-6 live projects) and project brokers/channel partners in Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar, Surat, Vadodara, Rajkot and other Gujarat towns. Not national chains, not the large groups that obviously run an in-house CRM or call centre.
need_analysis.decision_maker: Owner / managing partner / promoter, or the sales head in a mid-size firm (in small firms the promoter himself answers the phone).
observable_signals: Live Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ads whose button opens WhatsApp (cta_type WHATSAPP_MESSAGE or a wa.me link): pay now + WhatsApp is the enquiry door
A new project registered with GujRERA in the last ~90 days: launch means an enquiry wave; the register publishes promoter name, project, district and (sometimes) a business email
Job posts for pre-sales executive, telecaller, CRM or lead follow-up executive at a real-estate firm: enquiries are handled by people, and the firm is scaling that
A WhatsApp number or wa.me button printed as the main enquiry route on the firm's own site / project page, with no chat or booking flow (fingerprint: no bot or CRM widget)
Paid portal presence (99acres / MagicBricks / Housing builder profile and new-launch tags)
Customer reviews saying nobody replied or picked up (symptom; rare in practice)
Stall at a property expo (shows the firm pays for enquiries)
where_signals_show: Meta Ad Library (facebook.com/ads/library) and the advertiser Page
GujRERA public register (gujrera.gujarat.gov.in project_reg public API)
Job boards: Naukri (dated, company-posted), Indeed India; aggregator pages like Weekday/WorkIndia carry no posting date
Developer websites, Facebook/Instagram business pages, Google Business listings
Property portals (99acres, MagicBricks, Housing) - plain fetch returns HTTP 403
Property expo exhibitor pages and local news launch coverage
disqualifiers: National or listed chains and franchises; large Gujarat groups with an obvious in-house CRM, call centre or bot
Agencies, freelancers, CRM/chatbot/software vendors, portals and lead-gen brokers (they sell what we sell)
Outside Gujarat
Ad or job evidence older than ~90 days with nothing live today; ads not active on the send-day recheck
Confirmed existing automation (chat-widget vendor, crm./api_lead/webhook host, Firebase CRM name)
No business-published way to reach them (never guess an email or number)
Cannot verify the business exists, scams
Already in our leads (the 25 names given) or in the earlier researched pool

considered.source: Meta Ad Library (Facebook/Instagram ads) via Apify curious_coder/facebook-ads-library-scraper
considered.signal_for_this_need: Strongest. A developer whose live ad button opens WhatsApp is paying for enquiries AND sending them to a WhatsApp chat that a person must answer; start_date and is_active come from the data.
considered.reachability: Advertiser Page, website in link_url or Page about, wa.me number in the ad; no phone/email field in the ad data itself, so a second step finds the published contact.
considered.volume_in_geo: Measured 14 Oct: 18 queries gave 347 ads and about 140 advertisers; only ~20 of ~150 advertisers own a website. Pool is partly mined (several of the 25 known leads came from here), so expect 3-5 NEW pages after dedupe, not a fresh 140.
considered.risk: Bulk actors under-count ads per page (Swarna 1 vs 13); India spend/impressions are null; unofficial scraper of Meta data (ToS grey, no login used); Apify monthly cap was hit 15 Oct and may not have reset; ad liveness must be rechecked on the send day.
considered.why: Only source that shows spend and the WhatsApp door in the same record, with dates. Used for new cities/typologies and Gujarati keywords, not the old queries.

considered.source: GujRERA public register (new project registrations)
considered.signal_for_this_need: Medium-strong. A project approved in the last 90 days means a launch and an enquiry wave; says nothing alone about WhatsApp, so it must be joined to an ad or a published WhatsApp route.
considered.reachability: Promoter name, project, district, masked/partial contacts via the public API; only ~7 of 159 fresh promoters used a business-domain email (~150 Gmail), so most go to a phone/own-site route found by web search.
considered.volume_in_geo: Measured: about 130 projects registered in the five big cities between 2026-08-15 and 2026-10-14; 159 fresh promoters; 25 already pulled (round3_rera_contacts.csv).
considered.risk: Undocumented internal API (may change); the list call is a POST that earlier scripts ran with curl -k --tlsv1.2 (python ssl fails); I confirmed the GET host answers HTTP 200 over normal TLS today but arbitrary projectRegId 32000 and 31800 returned empty data, so IDs must come from the list call; register data is personal for proprietors, keep minimum.
considered.why: Free, dated, covers towns beyond the big five, and produced Great Spaces (best lead of round 2). Different door from the ad library, so it adds new names.

considered.source: Job posts: Naukri via Apify valig/naukri-jobs-scraper (+ Indeed India by web)
considered.signal_for_this_need: Strong and NEW for this campaign: a developer hiring a pre-sales executive, telecaller or CRM/lead follow-up person is handling enquiries by hand and is paying to do more of it. Posting date (createdDateText) comes from the data.
considered.reachability: Output has company.name, company.websiteUrl, company.address; then own site/Google listing for a published phone or email. Consultant postings can be filtered out (jobPostType = Company jobs).
considered.volume_in_geo: Not measured yet; assumption of 20-40 company-posted real-estate sales/pre-sales jobs per big-city query in 30 days, fewer in Surat/Vadodara/Rajkot/Gandhinagar. Aggregators (Weekday, WorkIndia) show roles but no posting date (checked on a Kautilya Group page), so they cannot be evidence.
considered.risk: Many postings are by brokerages, portals and consultants or by big chains; hiring is a weaker proxy than ads (LinkedIn jobs scored 0/28 for IT-services intent, a different need); a team that just hired callers may resist a bot; Naukri blocks bots so the actor needs its proxy.
considered.why: Observes the people-dependent reply directly and finds small local firms that do not advertise on Meta, so it adds leads the ad-library and RERA routes miss.

chosen.name: Meta Ad Library: live click-to-WhatsApp ads from Gujarat developers (new cities, new typologies, Gujarati keywords)
chosen.how_to_run: Actor: curious_coder/facebook-ads-library-scraper (id XtaWFhbtfxyzqrFmd; US$0.00075 per ad + US$0.00005 start; worked on 14 Oct). Input JSON: {"urls":[{"url":"https://www.facebook.com/ads/library/?active_status=active&ad_type=all&country=IN&start_date[min]=2026-08-01&q=3%20BHK%20Rajkot&search_type=keyword_unordered&media_type=all"},{...q=2%20BHK%20Surat},{...q=flats%20Vadodara},{...q=plots%20Gandhinagar},{...q=%E0%AA%AB%E0%AB%8D%E0%AA%B2%E0%AB%87%E0%AA%9F%20(Gujarati for 'flat')}],"limitPerSource":24,"count":120,"scrapeAdDetails":false}. count=120 hard-caps spend near US$0.09; the actor may overshoot a per-URL limit by up to 30, so rely on count. On a free-tier account pass the platform's minimum maxTotalChargeUsd; real spend stays about US$0.09. Pull rows with get-dataset-items. Post-process by script, no model: start_date epoch to date; keep is_active=true; keep ads where snapshot.cta_type or any snapshot.cards[].cta_type is WHATSAPP_MESSAGE, or link_url host is wa.me / api.whatsapp.com / wa.link / fb.me; group by snapshot.page_id; drop any page whose name matches the 25 known leads or the earlier pool (agent/state/leads/trigger_leads_2026-10-14.csv, agent/state/campaigns/_research_raw*.json) by page_id, normalised name or domain; drop pages with page_like_count above ~50,000 or a national chain name; rank by number of WhatsApp-CTA ads in the sample, then newest start_date. For the top ~8 pages open the advertiser Page / Ad Library page view (view_all_page_id=<page_id>) and take the active-ad count from there (bulk actors under-count), then find the website, wa.me number, Google listing and any published email, each with its URL. Preflight: Apify monthly cap was hit on 15 Oct; if the first call returns a limit error, stop this source (do not retry) and switch to automation-lab/facebook-ads-library with {"searchQueries":["3 BHK Rajkot","2 BHK Surat","flats Vadodara","plots Gandhinagar"],"country":"IN","activeStatus":"active","onlyAdsNewerThan":"90 days","maxAds":30} (US$0.005 + US$0.0005 per ad), or skip it.
chosen.qualifying_signal: A local Gujarat real-estate developer or project-broker Page with at least one ad that is active today (is_active true on the recheck) whose CTA opens WhatsApp (WHATSAPP_MESSAGE or wa.me link), ad start date within ~90 days or still running, not a chain or reseller of one project only, and at least one business-published contact route with URL. One ad seen once is 'burst, unproven' until a recheck 48 h later.
chosen.fields_to_capture: page_id, page_name, page_profile_uri, page_like_count, ig_username and ig_followers, page_category, ad_archive_id, ad_library_url, start_date_formatted, is_active, cta_type, link_url, first 200 characters of ad body (project and city), RERA number token if present in the text, count of WhatsApp-CTA ads in the sample and the active count from the advertiser page, website domain, wa.me number, email/phone with source URL, observed_at date, source query
chosen.expected_yield: From ~120 ads: ~40-50 advertisers, ~25 with a WhatsApp CTA, ~8-12 new after dedupe, ~3-5 usable after the local/non-chain/contact check (estimate; the pool is partly mined)

chosen.name: GujRERA register: promoters with a project approved in the last ~90 days, joined to ads and enquiry routes
chosen.how_to_run: No Apify. Base URL https://gujrera.gujarat.gov.in/project_reg/public/ (undocumented; no login or captcha; the host answered HTTP 200 JSON with keys status, message, data, query, startWith, dataSize, sortBy, totalPages over normal TLS on 26 Oct). Step 1: POST .../filter-details with JSON {startDate:'2026-08-15', endDate:'2026-10-26', startWith:0, dataSize:500} (this filters by APPLICATION date; page with startWith) and take each projectRegId (31xxx-32xxx range; guessed IDs 32000 and 31800 returned empty data, so never guess). The POST needs curl --tlsv1.2 as in agent/workflows/campaign-lead-research-r2.js (python ssl fails); if the sandbox refuses curl, ask the owner for one allow rule rather than working around it. Step 2: GET .../alldatabyprojectid/{projectRegId} (WebFetch works for GETs) for promoterId, approvedDate (the real registration date), project name, type, district/taluka, promoter type, masked contacts; keep approvedDate >= 2026-07-28 and any Gujarat district (include Mehsana, Kalol, Sanand, Anand, Nadiad, Bharuch, Bhavnagar, Jamnagar, Morbi, Junagadh). Step 3: GET .../project-list-bypromoterid/{promoterId} and count the promoter's projects; 1-6 projects = small or mid, more than ~10 = reject as big. Step 4: dedupe by promoterId and normalised name against the 25 known leads, agent/state/leads/round3_rera_contacts.csv (25 promoters already pulled) and agent/state/campaigns/_research_raw*.json; drop national chains and well-known large groups. Step 5: for ~40 survivors run WebSearch/WebFetch '<promoter> <project> <city>' for own site, Facebook/Instagram Page and Google listing; check whether the promoter or project appears in source 1 (page name or RERA token in ad text); look on the project page for a WhatsApp/phone enquiry route and a chat/CRM widget (fingerprint). Personal data: keep only what a candidate needs and cite the register URL.
chosen.qualifying_signal: A promoter (not a chain) whose project has an approvedDate within 90 days, AND at least one of: a live Meta ad found in source 1 / on the advertiser Page, or a WhatsApp/phone enquiry route published on its own project page or Page with no chat or booking flow; AND a business-published contact with URL. Register alone, without ad or enquiry-route evidence, is capped at B.
chosen.fields_to_capture: promoterId, projectRegId, RERA registration number, promoter name and type, project name, district/taluka, approvedDate, promoter's total projects, register URL, own domain, website/Facebook/Instagram/Google listing URLs, WhatsApp number and where seen, email only if business-published (flag free-mail), ad evidence with date, widget/CRM fingerprint result, observed_at
chosen.expected_yield: ~130 projects in the big five cities over two months plus the rest of Gujarat; after dedupe and chain removal ~40-60 promoters to check, ~3-4 usable (only ~7 of 159 fresh promoters had a business email, so most leads will be phone or WhatsApp-route leads)

chosen.name: Job posts: real-estate firms in Gujarat hiring pre-sales / telecaller / lead follow-up staff (last 30 days)
chosen.how_to_run: Actor: valig/naukri-jobs-scraper (id U5tcRMY1heBYd1FYF; US$0.00036 per job + US$0.0009 start; ~11k users). Six small runs, each input {"keywords":K,"location":L,"sort":"f","jobAge":"30","jobPostType":["1"],"limit":40} (jobPostType 1 = company jobs, drops consultants; sort f = by date) with (K,L) = ('real estate pre sales','Ahmedabad'), ('real estate telecaller','Ahmedabad'), ('real estate pre sales','Surat'), ('real estate pre sales','Vadodara'), ('real estate pre sales','Rajkot'), ('real estate pre sales','Gandhinagar'). Cost per run about US$0.0153, six runs about US$0.09. Pull with get-dataset-items. Post-process by script: keep consultant=false; industry or description mentions real estate / construction / builder; title or role matches pre-sales, telecaller, telesales, CRM, lead/enquiry follow-up, sales coordinator, site sales; description mentions enquiries, leads, calls, follow-up, site visit or WhatsApp; createdDateText within 30 days; drop portals, brokerage franchises, listed chains and agencies; dedupe company.name / websiteUrl domain against the 25 known leads and the earlier pool. For survivors take company.websiteUrl and company.address from the output, then WebSearch/WebFetch the site and Google listing for a published phone, WhatsApp or email (URL each), and run the widget/CRM fingerprint; a job text that names a CRM tool (LeadSquared, Salesforce, Zoho CRM) is a resistance flag. Free web leg (no spend): WebSearch queries like '"pre sales executive" real estate developer Ahmedabad' restricted to in.indeed.com, apna.co and the firm's own careers page, accepting only pages that show a posting date. Do not use Weekday or WorkIndia pages as evidence (they print no date).
chosen.qualifying_signal: A Gujarat real-estate developer or builder (not a consultant, portal or chain) with a job post, dated within 30 days in the data, for a role whose title or duties are handling enquiries or leads (pre-sales, telecaller, CRM, follow-up), with the job URL, the posted date and a quoted duty line as evidence, and a business-published contact route.
chosen.fields_to_capture: job id and URL, title, createdDateText, company.name, company.websiteUrl, company.address, city, industry, vacancy count, applyCount, short quote of the duty line, whether CRM software is named, consultant flag, website/Google listing/Facebook URLs, phone/WhatsApp/email with source URL, observed_at
chosen.expected_yield: Not measured; assumption ~100 jobs over the six runs, ~30 unique companies, ~8-10 local developers after filters, ~2-4 usable (estimate)

plan_round1.if_low_yield: If the three sources give fewer than ~6 usable candidates: (1) Re-open the near-misses first: the 13 researched-but-uncontacted leads and the 22 never-qualified candidates in agent/state/campaigns/_research_raw*.json, plus the 16 phone-only click-to-WhatsApp advertisers held back in round 2, since they are already researched and cost almost nothing to recheck live. (2) Widen the Ad Library pull with more Gujarati and Hindi keywords (flat, bungalow, row house, plot, 'site visit', 'booking open'), small towns (Anand, Nadiad, Bharuch, Mehsana, Morbi, Junagadh, Bhavnagar, Jamnagar), and a second 120-ad batch for another ~US$0.09. (3) Add the fourth source: YouTube project walkthroughs with a published enquiry number (grow_media/youtube-search-api, q 'new project walkthrough Ahmedabad', publishedAfter 2026-08-01, regionCode IN, ~US$0.0006 per result; dates and numbers come from the data). (4) Broker lane: join GujRERA registered agents to Ad Library pages that run WhatsApp ads. (5) Portal builder names via memo23/99acres-property-scraper (includeProjects, US$0.0025 per result, needs its proxy) joined to GujRERA for contacts. (6) Check again in 2-3 weeks for announced property shows (Ahmedabad GIHED is usually January) and use exhibitor lists then. If Apify is still capped, run the registry source and the web leg of the job source only, and report that the ad-library source could not be run."

report.what_i_ran: Three runs of curious_coder/facebook-ads-library-scraper (XtaWFhbtfxyzqrFmd). Run 1 (Tuvq2ZIRW7roVFtNn): two Ad Library keyword URLs (3 BHK Rajkot, Gujarati 'flat'), active, India, count 40 -> 40 ads. Run 2 (8GXpvAZfcLSgXmbQD): three URLs (2 BHK Surat, flats Vadodara, plots Gandhinagar), count 78 -> 78 ads. Run 3 (sJ8gQtl43MJt4i86K): page-level recheck of Vacanza Developers, capped at 10 ads. Post-processing by hand: kept ads with cta_type WHATSAPP_MESSAGE or a link_url on api.whatsapp.com/wa.me, grouped by page, dropped the 25 known leads and the earlier pool (by name and by Facebook page URL against agent/state/campaigns and agent/state/leads). About 118 keyword ads gave roughly 70 advertisers and roughly 28 WhatsApp-button advertisers; about 14 of those were new developers. Free checks: WebSearch and WebFetch on Houssed, Ghar.tv, CommonFloor and aurumproptech RERA mirror pages to confirm that the business and project exist.

apify_runs.actor: curious_coder/facebook-ads-library-scraper (run sJ8gQtl43MJt4i86K, page-level recheck of Vacanza Developers)

report.worked: 1) Gujarati keyword and city keywords in the Ad Library surface many small local developers in Surat, Rajkot and Vadodara that run WhatsApp-button ads, and the ad body usually prints a business phone number, which is the usable contact route (source URL = the Ad Library ad id). 2) A page-level run of the actor (page URL, activeStatus active, country IN) returns that page's live ads plus pageInfo.ad_status and page creation date; for the top pick it showed 10+ live ads, 9 opening WhatsApp, which is much stronger than the one ad seen in the keyword run. Worth doing for the top 3-5 pages if budget allows (about US$0.0075 per 10 ads). 3) Houssed builder pages and the aurumproptech RERA mirror confirm project, promoter type and approval date for free. 4) Dedupe was needed: Sunfin Realty (partner brokerage of the known lead Shree Namasya, 3 WhatsApp ads) and Vatsalya Hilltop (earlier pool, phone-only) were dropped; Inaya Developer was dropped as an alias of Alisha Real Estate (its ad links the Alisha Instagram and Facebook profile 100087948232207, and its WhatsApp button is an AiSensy-generated link, so automation may exist).
report.did_not_work: 1) The start_date[min]=2026-08-01 URL filter is NOT honoured: ads started 2025-09, 2025-11, 2026-01 and 2026-02 came back, so date filtering must be done on start_date_formatted. 2) Keyword 'plots Gandhinagar' returned no usable plot or Gandhinagar developer; no Ahmedabad or Gandhinagar developer with a WhatsApp button surfaced at all (SJ Sangath, Arvind and Housiey appeared but are large or not WhatsApp). Coverage of Ahmedabad/Gandhinagar is a gap; next time try 'flats Ahmedabad', 'bungalows Ahmedabad', '2 BHK Gandhinagar' as separate keywords. 3) The planner counted link_url fb.me as a WhatsApp signal. It is not: fb.me with GET_QUOTE, SIGN_UP, BOOK_TRAVEL, GET_OFFER CTAs is a Meta instant lead form; counting them would have added about 25 false WhatsApp leads. I used only WHATSAPP_MESSAGE or an api.whatsapp.com / wa.me link. 4) Many keyword hits are noise: portals (99acres, Housing.com, Magicbricks, Housiey), a farmhouse rental (Palm Meadows, 7seas, Farmhouse junction), interior and furniture shops (R.H. Furniture), an astrologer, an optician, a kids-wear shop, a travel firm; DCO catalog ads have the body '{{product.brand}}' and no text. 5) Ad Library page view (view_all_page_id) returns HTTP 403 to WebFetch and Facebook pages return only the page title, so active-ad counts could only be taken from an Apify page-level run, which I did for one page only. 6) WebSearch finds only aggregator pages (Houssed, Ghar.tv, CommonFloor, RERA mirrors); none of these small developers has an own website or published business email that I could find, so all 12 candidates are phone-only (email_published false). Kelly La Maison, Reseed Infra and Eastprime could not be verified on any portal. 7) The GujRERA public API call with curl -k was refused by the permission system (TLS check disabled), and two WebSearch calls were also refused, so no register emails were fetched; retry with a proper TLS setup or a different tool if register contacts are wanted. 8) Dropped for no business-published contact route: Kelly La Maison (Kelila Mansion, Surat, 710 likes, WhatsApp ad 2026-10-09), The Unity Tower (Sarthana, ad since 2026-04-28), Surat City Property, Silver Stone Rajkot (may be linked to the known Silver Group), QBC Real estate Solution. Spare with phones but cut for the 12-cap: City post Rajkot (Panchvati Greens, page generic, ad started 2026-07-20, phones 88988 71471 / 88988 71571). Near-misses (paid ads and phone numbers but lead-form or call CTA, not WhatsApp): Kasturi Infraventures (Rajkot, 92747 50500), The Divine Group Rajkot, Century Regalia, Siddhi Group (Siddhi Space), Shree Gulmohar Residency (Rajkot), Silent Residency, Kuber Celebration and Amar Group (Vadodara), Shubh Group, Samarthya Group (Surat). 9) No 48 h recheck was possible, so every candidate except Vacanza (10 live ads, 5 days of starts) and The Skygaze (ad running since May) is 'burst, unproven'; re-pull the same ad ids after 2026-10-28 before any send. 10) Excluded as large or listed: 99acres, Housing.com, Magicbricks, Arvind SmartSpaces, Ascon Realty, Vihav, Sangini Group.

report.what_i_ran: No Apify. (1) Two POSTs to GujRERA filter-details with curl --tlsv1.2 (no -k): application window 2026-08-15..2026-10-26 gave 246 projects (84 approved) and 2026-06-01..2026-08-14 gave 320 (276 approved), because approval lags application by roughly 1-3 months. (2) 360 GETs on alldatabyprojectid for every approved project: 270 projects / 260 promoters have approvedDate >= 2026-07-28. (3) 260 GETs on project-list-bypromoterid for the project count per promoter. (4) Dedupe: 34 promoters dropped as already known (against the 25 campaign names, round3_rera_contacts.csv and _research_raw*.json; a few were false positives on generic names such as Shree/Ganesh/Shiv/Shreeji and were re-probed, nothing usable), 2 dropped as big (Rajhans 19 projects, Shrinivas 14), leaving 225 promoters (182 firms; 43 individuals/land-owner 'and others'). (5) Own-site discovery: because WebSearch was cut off, I probed about 4,200 guessed brand domains (promoter and project names, .com/.in/.co.in) with plain GETs and kept only pages that mention the project/promoter name plus a Gujarat place name; about 55 hit, 12 were genuine Gujarat identity matches. (6) For matched sites I read the raw HTML for WhatsApp/phone/email, chat or CRM scripts, Meta/Google Ads tags. Also about 15 WebSearch calls (about 10 returned results before the shared 200-per-turn budget ran out) and about 12 WebFetch calls.
report.worked: The GujRERA API works with curl --tlsv1.2 and normal certificate checks; no captcha or login. Approved-date lag matters: filter-details by application date only returned 84 approved projects, so a second earlier window was needed to catch approvals from 2026-07-28. The register email for most small promoters is a per-project RERA gmail, while the phone is the usable contact. Raw-HTML fingerprinting by curl gave facts WebFetch cannot show (script sources, Google Ads AW- tag, chat-tool CSS residue). Domain probing works only when the page is checked for project name + Gujarat place name; it found the Shafalya, Shaleenta, Aalayam, Aarana, Avani, Pavitraa and Atlanta sites. The strongest register-to-site match is by email domain (info@sunbuildcon.com appears on both).
report.did_not_work: (a) curl -k was blocked by the sandbox as a TLS weakening; plain curl --tlsv1.2 with certificate checks works fine, so -k (named in the shared GujRERA notes) should be dropped. (b) WebSearch: the 200-per-turn budget is shared across all collectors and ran out after about 15 of my calls; the results that did come back were only aggregators (Housiey, Houssed, Aurum, Ghar.tv, Paperli) and never a fresh promoter's own site; fresh one-project partnerships have almost no web footprint, so search yields about zero for them. (c) Domain guessing has a heavy false-positive rate: same-named developers matched in Faridabad, Guwahati, Nagpur, Chennai, Navi Mumbai, Talegaon, Delhi/Punjab and a Surat banquet hall (Parth Infra 'The Amore'); about 5 true hits per 4,000 probes, so each hit needs a city + project + phone/email match. (d) Business-domain emails in the register are almost absent: of 270 recent projects only 5 have a non-free email (Pacifica = a large 1978 group whose domain just shows an HR login page; SNS Divine = parked Hostinger domain; Shree Krishna Infra = unrelated tax-site domain; plus Sun Buildcon and Shafalya, which are returned). (e) No ad evidence: Meta Ad Library was not reachable (no browser, Apify not used per the plan) and I did not see source 1's output, so none of the 8 has confirmed Meta spend; only Shafalya has a Google Ads tag. (f) WebFetch shows page text only: it cannot see script sources, and JS shells (Courtyard Group, Next.js) return only a loader. (g) Dropped on purpose: Sangini Group/Vee Aar Life Space LLP (claims 71 projects, large Surat group), Pacifica (large, international), Art Nirman Ltd and Yash Innoventures Ltd (look like listed companies), Rudra Builders (investor-relations site, large), Crown Developers (site says Botad, register says Bhavnagar), JJ Developers and Aaron Infra (site does not mention the registered project). Worth a browser look next round: Courtyard Group / Ved Buildwell Ltd, Vadodara (register: Courtyard Enclave approved 2026-10-08 and Courtyard White Field 2026-10-17, 9 register projects, courtyardgroup.in is a JS-only site whose contacts I could not read). The 43 individual/'and others' land-owner entries (mostly Bhavnagar, Surat) were skipped as unlikely buyers.

report.what_i_ran: Seven runs of valig/naukri-jobs-scraper (input: sort f, jobAge 30, jobPostType company jobs, limits 40/40/40/40/40/40 then a final 15): pre sales in Ahmedabad (40 items), telecaller in Ahmedabad (24), pre sales in Surat (40), Vadodara (40), Rajkot (30), Gandhinagar (24), plus one extra telecaller run for Surat (9, limit 15). About 207 job rows in total. I filtered by hand for real-estate developers/brokers in Gujarat with enquiry/lead/site-visit duties and dropped listed or national firms, NBFCs and banks. For the 4 survivors I checked company identity and contacts on their own sites with WebFetch (nandanbaug.com, sparkinframark.com and /contact, vasanigroup.co.in and /contact and /career, goyalco.com, rewarealtors.com, relify.in) and used one apify/rag-web-browser query (2 pages) to find Rewa Realtors' site. The WebSearch budget (shared, 200 per turn) ran out partway, so the last identity searches were done with direct fetches only.
report.worked: The Naukri actor returns the posting date (createdDateText, to the second), the full duty text, vacancy and applicant counts, so dated evidence is solid and cheap (about US$0.0153 per 40-row run, 7-second runs). Two of the four survivors (Spark Inframark, Nandanbaug Galaxy LLP) could be tied to their own website by the street address in the job data. That address match is a useful identity check when company.websiteUrl is empty. Footers of small-developer sites carry phone, email and often a WhatsApp link, so contacts were easy to source once the site was found. A site-vendor fingerprint turned up: Spark's footer 'Powered By Relify' (Relify sells real-estate websites with lead management and CRM/WhatsApp add-ons).
report.did_not_work: 1) Naukri keyword search is loose. 'real estate pre sales' returns mostly NBFCs, solar, IT, edtech, interiors and building-material sales; only about 10 of roughly 207 rows were real-estate developer or broker posts, and only 3 of those had enquiry-handling duties. Rajkot returned 30 jobs with zero real-estate developer posts, Gandhinagar returned only SOBHA (listed, GIFT City) and JLL, and the Surat telecaller run returned zero real estate. Expect about 3-4 usable per ~200 rows, below the planner's 2-4 per 100 estimate. 2) company.websiteUrl is empty for nearly every small developer, so each site had to be found separately, and WebSearch is poor at tiny Gujarat firms (it returned portal pages, not their sites). Guessing domains worked once (sparkinframark.com), failed for pramukhorganisation.com and for Rewa Realtor (rewarealtors.com was found only through the rag-web-browser search). 3) Blocked or unusable: in.indeed.com returns HTTP 403, naukri.com company pages return 403, goyalandco.com returns 403 (goyalco.com worked), DuckDuckGo html search shows a bot challenge (not bypassed), apna.co listing pages carry no posting dates (cannot be used as evidence), Weekday/WorkIndia not tried (no dates). 4) Aggregated Naukri posts ('aggregated from external source': Rudra Infrastructure & Advisory, Galaxygroup) have thin text and no company identity, so they are not usable on their own. 5) Dropped after review: Goyal & Co (Ahmedabad, 250+ projects, 13 live projects across Ahmedabad and Bengaluru, 5 sales vacancies, 'maintain CRM' in the JD: large with probable in-house team); Pramukh Organisation, Surat (Junior Sales Exec 2026-10-16, 'Generate leads... follow up', but no website or contact found); Rudra Infrastructure & Advisory (telesales post 2026-10-16 to 'schedule appointments for site visits', but aggregated and identity unverifiable); Dharmadev Infrastructure, Mayfair Housing, Classic Build Projects, Gokul Lifespaces (civil/legal/construction roles, not enquiry handling); SOBHA, JLL, Tata Capital, Bajaj Finance (chains/finance). 6) Names surfaced by WebSearch from Indeed/Apna without any dates and therefore not usable as evidence: Rajshree Group, Sattva Shravana Spacess (Shilaj), Brookfieldz (Vadodara), Samarthya Group (Surat), Shivdhara Realty (Makarba), Velocity Infinite Realty, Veer Real Estate, Tejoria Infra. These could be checked by the next round if a dated source is found. 7) Suggestion for next time: job posts are a thin source for this niche (3-4 per 200 rows). Combine Naukri with Meta Ad Library (WhatsApp-CTA ads) for the same firms, e.g. check Sparkinframark and Nandanbaug there. The planned free Indeed/Apna leg cannot give dated evidence.

judged.replan_advice: enough=true (15 usable), no replan is needed. For the next round: (1) No duplicates or aliases were found across the three sources, and none of the 15 appear in the local leads state or the 25 listed leads (Rameshwaram Group still needs an alias check against Rameshwar Developers). (2) Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar are under-covered in Meta results: try separate keywords such as 'flats Ahmedabad', 'bungalows Ahmedabad' and '2 BHK Gandhinagar', and Gujarati keywords for Rajkot and Gandhinagar. (3) Filter ad dates on start_date_formatted, because the date URL filter is ignored, and count only WHATSAPP_MESSAGE or api.whatsapp.com / wa.me links, not fb.me lead forms. (4) Run the page-level Ad Library recheck (about US$0.0075 per page) on the top Meta pages and on register/Naukri leads (Shafalya, Sparkinframark, Nandanbaug, Sun Buildcon) to get spend evidence, and re-pull the same ad ids after 2026-10-28 before any send. (5) GujRERA works with plain curl --tlsv1.2 (drop -k); a second earlier application-date window is needed to catch approvals; most register emails are free-mail, so contacts must come from the firm's own site or ad. Sun Buildcon's register evidence passes 90 days on 2026-10-30, and Shaleenta's around 2026-11-11. (6) Naukri is a thin source here, so use it only combined with a Meta check; look at Courtyard Group (Vadodara) in a browser. (7) For the small-developer long tail, add a cross-check step that matches the ad's project name to the RERA register before the judge, so existence is settled earlier.

observed_facts.fact: Page 'Vacanza Developers' had 6 active Meta ads in my sample (limit 6, so the real count may be higher). Start dates run from 2026-10-16 to 2026-10-23. The ad IDs are 2433420887396586, 2888274911535780, 2671300023268401, 1766533534650500, 2103795657243686 and 1683522276522217.

5 of the 6 ads have CTA WHATSAPP_MESSAGE ('Send WhatsApp message'). The sixth has CTA 'Book now' with link api.whatsapp.com/send. All 6 list WhatsApp among the publisher platforms, alongside Facebook, Instagram and, for one ad, Audience Network.

The ad copy closes with a call or enquiry ask: 'Aaj hi call karein aur site visit/bookings ki details jaaniye', 'Aaj hi enquiry karein', 'Enquire Now for Details & Site Visit' with +91 90999 73209. The 2 BHK ad (started 2026-10-21) says '5 Days Left', so that offer ended around 2026-10-26.

hypotheses: INFERENCE: Click-to-WhatsApp enquiries from several simultaneous ads probably arrive in the evening and at night. A time-boxed offer ('5 Days Left') makes reply speed matter more. Nothing observed shows how fast they actually reply.

INFERENCE: The ad copy pushes 'call' and 'site visit' and prints a phone number next to a WhatsApp button, so first replies are probably handled by people. This is not observed, and an auto-greeting or a WhatsApp Business API system may already exist.
INFERENCE: With four product lines, WhatsApp enquiries probably land with no shared list for the sales team. The evidence is only that the ads run several lines under one Page.

INFERENCE: The mix of dynamic-creative ads, several lines and a dated promotion suggests an in-house marketer or an ad agency runs the campaigns. An agency could hold the WhatsApp setup and be the real gatekeeper.

INFERENCE: The ad burst coincides with the festival season (Diwali is about 8 Nov 2026) and may be a seasonal push, not a year-round stream. The finder's 'continuous' is not shown by my data, which covers only about 10 days.
dossier.ability_to_pay: A multi-project developer in Surat with residential, retail and premium office stock in Vesu and Althan. At least 6 verified active ads in the same week across several formats and platforms, plus a 4,101-follower Page and an Instagram account. Spend is not disclosed, and I saw no ad history before 2026-10-16. The pay signal is relative to a small automation subscription, not a measured budget.
dossier.decision_maker: not found. No public page I could read names an owner, director or sales head (CommonFloor and the Facebook and Instagram pages name nobody). The official site could not be rendered, so a team or about page may exist there.
dossier.size_cues: Four named product lines or projects (Vacanza City, Atlas, Shopping Street, Homes; the last is from the finder, not re-verified). Offices in Vesu (Harrod's). CommonFloor shows only 1 ongoing project and no years in business. Facebook: 4,101 followers and 134 check-ins. Instagram: 3,345 followers. This is a mid-size local developer with no sign of being a chain or franchise. The finder's 'Page created 2017' is unverified.
dossier.resistance: Unknown, not high on the evidence. I found no sign of a bot, a WhatsApp BSP or a CRM, and no anti-AI positioning, but I could not see the site. Likely gatekeepers are an ad agency or a marketing person behind the ads. The owner is not named, so the first conversation would be with whoever answers the printed sales line. The ad copy leans on calls and site visits, which suggests a human-led sales culture. Past Campaign 1 results (cold WhatsApp templates 0/3) argue against a cold WhatsApp opener.
dossier.case_for: Real, verified local developer (Facebook Page, Instagram and CommonFloor all agree). It actively buys Meta ads, and at least 6 were live in the same week, mostly with a WhatsApp button that sends enquiries to WhatsApp. The ad copy pushes site visits and booking enquiries, and a dated offer makes reply speed matter. Nothing in the data points to a duplicate, a chain or a competitor, and a sales number is published in its own ad.
dossier.case_against: The need is only inferred: a WhatsApp CTA is standard for Indian real-estate ads and does not show slow replies. I could not open the finder's ad, check the site, find an owner or email, or confirm the number is a sales desk and not an agency's. The ad stream may be a festival-season burst, and an agency or an existing auto-reply may already cover the need. This sits at the weak edge of B and drops to C if the number turns out to be an agency line or the site shows a working chatbot or WhatsApp Business API setup.
dossier.best_angle: Ask, do not assert. Open with their live Vacanza City 2 BHK and Atlas ads ('Send WhatsApp message' button, Rs 4 lakh booking offer): 'Someone taps your button at 11 pm. Does anyone reply before morning?' Then offer a first reply in about a minute with the brochure, 3 quick questions and a site-visit slot, and one list for the sales team across all four projects. Do not claim they reply slowly.
dossier.best_channel: A human phone call to the sales number printed in their own ad (+91 90999 73209), asking for the owner or sales head and for an email address. It is the only business-published route found. Do not use a cold WhatsApp template (0/3 in Campaign 1), and do not message through the ad button or the Page, since that would pose as a buyer. Before calling, someone should open vacanzadevelopers.com in a normal browser to find an email, form or owner name and to check for an existing chatbot.

fit.rationale_quality: Strong and specific to this need. The plan separates three observable parts of the need: they pay for enquiries now, enquiries arrive on WhatsApp or phone, and the reply depends on people. It maps each part to a public trace. Click-to-WhatsApp ads cover spend plus the WhatsApp door. A fresh GujRERA approval covers a launch and an enquiry wave. Pre-sales and telecaller job posts cover people-dependent replies. Thirteen sources are weighed with per-source reachability, cost, risk and a reason for each verdict. Many rejections cite earlier measurements (Maps reviews 0 of 81, JustDial and IndiaMART masked contacts, community sources 0 usable). The sources were also adjusted to this need: Gujarati keywords, Gujarat towns, and a ban on counting fb.me instant-form ads as WhatsApp. The run reports are candid about what failed. They found that the ad date filter is ignored, that fb.me is not WhatsApp, and that curl -k was refused. They also found that Naukri keyword search is loose (about 4 of 207 rows usable). Weaker points: the 'if low yield' fallbacks are generic. The trio of ad library, register and jobs is a fairly standard intent-signal set, though the specifics here are need-driven.
suspicious_candidates: Nandanbaug Galaxy LLP: the job text says 'maintain CRM' and names Sales, CRM and Channel Partner teams. It is a diversified group with about 15 open posts, so an in-house CRM or call team is likely. This is a disqualifier by the plan's own rule (large group with an obvious in-house CRM) and should be tested hard.

Shafalya Infra LLP: rated 'high' confidence with no Meta ad evidence. Its Inquire Now consent already covers WhatsApp/SMS/RCS follow-up, and leftover Tidio/Chaty CSS suggests chat or follow-up tooling was tried. It has 4 RERA plus 4 ongoing projects and a Google Ads account. It may already have automation, so the need is inferred, not observed.

Sun Buildcon Pvt. Ltd.: the need signal is an absence (no WhatsApp route). It is a firm operating since 1980 with 8 projects. Two of its three approvals are already 103-105 days old, past the 90-day rule. This is fit-by-profile.
Subodh Developers LLP: corporate office in Mumbai and a free-mail contact. The project is in Vadodara, but the business may not be a Gujarat firm.
Kishan Antilia: the developer entity comes only from aggregators (Ambica Infracon vs the Kishan brand). Only one ad was seen.

fit.notes: The yield figures are consistent and the reports disclose the failures. The per-source tallies (7+6+2=15) match the candidate list and the dropped list. The run came out above the plan's estimate (about 8-13 expected, 15 reported), and the plan's own bar for enough was about 6 usable. Four caveats: (1) 'usable' is looser than it sounds. Only Vacanza has a page-level recheck. The other ad candidates are single-ad bursts with no 48 h recheck. Contacts are phone-only except for the sites that publish an email. Seven of the 15 have only free-mail or no usable business contact, or no ad evidence at all. Evidence-wise, the realistic strong set is roughly Vacanza, Shafalya, Spark and the fresh WhatsApp-ad pages. (2) The planned join of RERA to Meta ads never ran, because the register collector could not see source 1. None of the register candidates has ad evidence, and the 'high' confidence on Shafalya is generous. (3) The buyer profile says developers and project brokers, but all 15 candidates are developers. The broker lane was never worked. There is also no Ahmedabad or Gandhinagar developer from the ad library and no Rajkot candidate from jobs or register (one from ads). The first Gujarat city is the biggest market, and the plan avoided Ahmedabad queries because the pool was partly mined. (4) The register collector probed about 4,200 guessed domains. That was cheap and read-only, but it is a brute-force substitute for a blocked WebSearch, and it produced only 12 genuine matches. Those matches were checked by name plus place, so it is not a defect, but it is not repeatable evidence for the source. Courtyard Group (Vadodara) is flagged for a browser look.
sources_that_should_have_been_considered: Meta Ad Library with Ahmedabad-specific keywords (flats, bungalows, 2 BHK Ahmedabad, 2 BHK Gandhinagar). The biggest city was left out of the planned queries and no Ahmedabad developer with a WhatsApp button surfaced.

The broker lane: GujRERA registered agents or channel-partner pages joined to Ad Library pages that run WhatsApp ads. It was rejected as 'reserve' even though project brokers are half the stated buyer.

Facebook and Instagram developer pages with a WhatsApp or Message button and recent organic posts, for firms that do not run ads. Facebook pages returned only page titles to plain fetch, so a browser or Apify page-level pass would be needed.
Google Business Profile listings used for WhatsApp or booking links and 'Messages' enablement, beyond the contact-lookup role they were given.

The previously researched near-misses (16 phone-only click-to-WhatsApp advertisers, 13 researched-but-uncontacted leads, and lead-form or call-CTA advertisers such as Kasturi Infraventures and Divine Group Rajkot). They were put in the low-yield fallback only, although they are cheap to recheck live and would have covered Rajkot.
A browser-based look at JS-only developer sites (Courtyard Group, Vadodara), which plain GET and WebFetch cannot read.

scrape.campaign: Institute management software for coaching classes and tuition institutes (Gujarat)
scrape.need: Coaching classes and tuition institutes with several batches or branches manage admissions, fees and attendance by hand (registers, Excel, WhatsApp groups) and lose time and fees

need_analysis.summary: Owners of coaching classes and tuition institutes with several batches or branches still run admissions (enquiry, form, fee), fee collection and reminders, attendance and parent updates through registers, Excel and WhatsApp groups, so staff time and fees leak. Nobody posts 'I need institute software', so the need is latent. We have to find it through structural proxies (more than one branch, many batches) and behaviours that show manual handling (admission by WhatsApp or Google Form, paid admission ads that land on WhatsApp), and then confirm there is no existing system.
need_analysis.who_has_this_need: Locally founded, owner-run coaching or tuition institutes in Ahmedabad, Surat, Vadodara, Rajkot, Gandhinagar and Mehsana. Typical types: GSEB std 6-10 tuition groups, 11-12 commerce and science classes, GUJCET/JEE/NEET and CA foundation coaching, spoken English and IELTS academies. They run 2 or more branches or many parallel batches, roughly 200-3000 students. Pain grows with each branch added.
observable_signals: Same local brand listed at 2 or more addresses ('Brand - Area' repeated, shared phone numbers, same website on several Maps pins)
Running paid admission ads (Meta) in Gujarati or English, especially ads that open WhatsApp or a lead form, which means enquiries are handled by hand
Website or ad shows admission by Google Form, 'WhatsApp us to register', pay-at-office, or a batch timetable image, and no student/parent login or app
Branch-wise Maps listings each with its own phone and WhatsApp number
Hiring admission counsellor, centre/branch manager, front-office or accounts executive (admin load, expansion)
Reviews or posts that mention fee receipts, attendance messages, parents not informed, or batch confusion
Recent admission-season activity for 2026-27: batch start dates, result posts, new-branch posts
where_signals_show: Coaching directories (TargetStudy city/category lists) where branches appear as separate rows
Google Maps listings and their website field
Meta Ad Library (active ads, landing link, CTA type, start date)
The institute's own website: branches/contact/admission pages, footer 'powered by', app links
Job boards (Naukri) for non-teaching roles
Google Play only as a disqualifier check (own Classplus/Teachmint-type app means a system exists)
disqualifiers: National or listed chains and franchises: ALLEN, Aakash, FIITJEE, Resonance, PW Vidyapeeth, Narayana, Career Point, Motion, Sri Chaitanya, Byju's, Vedantu, Unacademy, and similar
Coaching-software vendors, agencies and competitors (for example EduTask/Arianus Technocraft Ahmedabad, Classplus, Teachmint, Classpro, CoachPlus, BatchBoard)
Schools, colleges and universities (a different product and buyer)
Single-tutor home tuition or an individual's personal phone (personal data, no multi-batch need)
Already running a full LMS/ERP/parent app, shown by a login portal or 'powered by' footer
Outside the six cities
Cannot be verified as operating in 2026 (directory rows can be years old; one TargetStudy profile showed 'updated 05-Jul-2021')
Only an unverified directory phone and no own site, own Maps listing or own ad
need_analysis.decision_maker: Founder, owner or director of the institute (often also the main teacher). Branch heads can be a second route, but the owner signs.

considered.source: Meta (Facebook/Instagram) Ad Library via Apify curious_coder/facebook-ads-library-scraper

Round 5 on 2026-10-14 showed ad-library advertisers gave the best A/B yield of any source tried (13 A and 16 B of 30 enriched, for a different vertical). Gujarati keywords (એડમિશન ચાલુ, GUJCET, GSEB) pull local institutes and avoid national chains.
considered.reachability: Good: the ad link gives the website or a wa.me number the business itself published, and the page name lets us find the site. No spend, phone or email columns for India.
considered.volume_in_geo: Unknown until run; estimate about 100 ads giving 35-45 advertisers, 10-20 Gujarat coaching or tuition
considered.risk: Third-party actor on public transparency data; Meta ToS grey. Ad liveness cannot be re-checked later. Chains and edtech apps will dominate unless Gujarati queries are used.

chosen.name: Meta Ad Library: local institutes running admission ads (Gujarati and English keywords)
chosen.how_to_run: Actor curious_coder/facebook-ads-library-scraper ($0.00075 per ad plus $0.00005 start). Input: {"urls":[<4 Ad Library search URLs>],"limitPerSource":25,"count":100,"scrapeAdDetails":false}. URL template: https://www.facebook.com/ads/library/?active_status=active&ad_type=all&country=IN&search_type=keyword_unordered&media_type=all&q=<URL-encoded query>. The four queries: (1) એડમિશન ચાલુ ટ્યુશન ક્લાસીસ, (2) GUJCET coaching admission, (3) GSEB tuition classes admission, (4) coaching classes Ahmedabad admission. If the Gujarati queries return nothing, try the transliteration 'admission chalu che tuition'. Hard cap: count 100 (about $0.075). Post-process free: group by page_id; read page name, snapshot.link_url, snapshot.cta_type, start_date, is_active and the ad text; drop national chains and edtech apps (list in disqualifiers), software vendors and single-tutor pages; keep pages whose ad text or page shows batches or several branches or addresses. For each kept page, WebFetch the ad's landing website or wa.me link and its contact page, and check for a student/parent login or 'powered by' footer (existing system = drop). Contact only from the landing site or the wa.me number in the ad.
chosen.qualifying_signal: A Gujarat-based coaching or tuition institute (not a chain) with at least one ad active now or started within about 90 days, selling admission or batches, whose landing is WhatsApp, a lead form or Google Form, and who shows batches or branches (plural batches in text, several addresses, or a branch name list), with no sign of an existing parent/student app or ERP.
chosen.expected_yield: About 100 ads, 35-45 distinct advertisers, 10-20 Gujarat coaching or tuition pages, 6-10 after chain, vendor and individual removal, 3-5 with a published contact and branch or batch evidence.
chosen.fields_to_capture: page name, page_id, ad library URL, ad start_date, is_active, cta_type, landing URL or wa.me number, ad text excerpt in quotes under 15 words, city or area, branches or batches mentioned, existing-system check result

chosen.name: Google Maps: verify directory brands and list the thin cities (Gandhinagar, Mehsana)
chosen.how_to_run: Actor scrapesage/google-maps-scraper ($0.00135 per place), fallback compass/crawler-google-places ($0.003 per place, cap 30 places). Run A, one run per thin city, input: {"searchQueries":["coaching classes","tuition classes"],"locationQuery":"Gandhinagar, Gujarat, India","countryCode":"in","language":"en","maxPlacesPerSearch":8,"maxResults":16,"skipClosedPlaces":true,"withPhoneOnly":true,"categoryFilterWords":["coaching","tutor","tuition","academy","institute","classes"],"enrichContacts":false,"scrapePlaceDetails":false}; repeat with "Mehsana, Gujarat, India". Run B, verification of up to 10 multi-branch brands shortlisted by the directory source (for example 'Bothra Classes Ahmedabad', 'Boson Academy Ahmedabad', 'Eagle Classes Surat'), input: {"searchQueries":["<brand> <city>", ...10 terms],"locationQuery":"","countryCode":"in","maxPlacesPerSearch":3,"maxResults":30,"skipClosedPlaces":true}. Hard cap about 62 places, about $0.085. Post-process free: normalise names and group by brand token, website domain and phone; a brand with 2 or more open pins in different areas counts as multi-branch; WebFetch each website (if any) for branches, admission form type, student/parent login or 'powered by' footer, and a 2026 date on the page.
chosen.qualifying_signal: An open (not closed) local coaching or tuition brand with at least 2 Maps pins in different areas (or one pin plus a website that lists branches), a phone or website on its own listing, a 2026-dated proof of operation (admission 2026-27 or batch dates on its site, or Maps shows open), and no existing parent/student app or ERP.
chosen.expected_yield: About 30-60 places, 6-10 distinct brands, of which 2-4 are new multi-branch candidates in Gandhinagar and Mehsana or Surat/Rajkot brands needing verification. Also converts directory seeds into verified candidates, 4-6 survive.
chosen.fields_to_capture: place name, Maps URL, address and area, city, phone, website, rating, open status, brand group id, number of pins in the brand, website branch list URL, admission form type, evidence date and URL

chosen.name: TargetStudy directory: mine multi-branch local coaching brands, then audit their own sites
chosen.how_to_run: Free, using WebFetch and WebSearch only (about 30-40 fetches). List URL pattern: https://targetstudy.com/coaching/<category>-coaching-in-<city>.htm?recNo=<0,20,40,...>. Categories: 9th-10th, 6th-8th, 11th-12th-commerce, 11th-12th-medical-non-medical, jee, medical-entrance-exams, ca-cs-icwa. Cities: ahmedabad, surat, vadodara, rajkot, gandhinagar, mehsana. Start with 9th-10th and 11th-12th-commerce plus jee for the first 3 pages of each of the 4 big cities, then the rest if budget of time allows. Prompt for each fetch: 'List every institute with name, area and phones; flag any brand that appears 2 or more times (pattern Brand - Area) or shares a phone number; do not quote long text'. Exclude chains (ALLEN, Aakash, FIITJEE, Resonance, PW, Narayana, Career Point, Byju's and similar). Then for each multi-branch brand run WebSearch '<brand> <city> classes official website' and WebFetch the own site (branches, contact, admission pages). Look for: admission through a Google Form or WhatsApp number, pay-at-office or UPI QR for fees, batch timetable as an image, no student/parent login, no Classplus/Teachmint/other 'powered by' footer, and a 2026-27 date. Verify liveness with the Maps source above. Skip rows that look like an individual home tutor (personal number).
chosen.qualifying_signal: One local brand listed at 2 or more branches (distinct areas or cities, or shared phone), confirmed alive in 2026 by its own site, Maps or an ad, with a business-published contact on its own site or listing, and evidence of manual handling (Google Form, WhatsApp-only enquiry, no portal) or at least no sign of a system.
chosen.expected_yield: Roughly 12-20 multi-branch local brands found in the lists; after chain removal and liveness proof about 5-8 usable. Directory phones alone do not count, so some will drop.
chosen.fields_to_capture: brand, list of branch rows with area and phone, directory page URL, own website URL, branches page URL, contact page URL, admission mechanism seen, existing-system check result, date seen on page, city

plan_round1.if_low_yield: If fewer than about 8 candidates survive, in this order: (1) Naukri jobs via valig/naukri-jobs-scraper (about $0.04): keywords 'admission counsellor coaching', 'branch manager coaching institute', 'centre head tuition classes', location Ahmedabad/Surat/Vadodara/Rajkot, jobAge 30, limit 100; use company.websiteUrl and company.address, drop chains and edtech. (2) Cross-signal pass: take the brands from directory and Maps and scrape their Facebook Page ads with curious_coder (page URL input, limitPerSource 5, about $0.004 per brand); a multi-branch brand with live admission ads is the strongest candidate. (3) More directory depth: the remaining TargetStudy categories (spoken English, IELTS, CA/CS, 6-8th) and the Maps queries 'IELTS coaching', 'commerce classes', 'NEET coaching', 'GUJCET' and Gujarati 'ક્લાસીસ' per big city, with scrapePlaceDetails on for review counts. (4) Free WebSearch queries with Gujarati keywords and negative terms (-allen -aakash -pw) aimed at institute sites that list 'our branches'. (5) For at most 10 finalists, pull recent Google reviews filtered by 'fees', 'attendance', 'parents' (compass, about $0.0005 per review) as direct pain evidence. (6) Do not widen the geography or relax the chain and vendor rules."

report.what_i_ran: Run 1 (planned): curious_coder/facebook-ads-library-scraper with 4 Ad Library keyword URLs (Gujarati 'admission chalu tuition classes', 'GUJCET coaching admission', 'GSEB tuition classes admission', 'coaching classes Ahmedabad admission'), active ads, India, limitPerSource 10, count 40, maxTotalChargeUsd 0.1, maxItems 40. Run 2 (one adaptation, same signal): 6 new URLs ('admission chalu che tuition', 'tuition classes Surat admission', 'commerce science classes Vadodara admission', 'coaching classes Rajkot admission', 'tuition classes Gandhinagar Mehsana admission', '11 12 commerce classes Ahmedabad admission'), limitPerSource 8, count 40, cap 0.05. Post-processing by grouping on page_id: 5 distinct advertisers in 9 ad rows total. Then free WebFetch/WebSearch identity checks on the 3 kept pages (edugreed.com fetched twice, a Katargam directory listing, mathsci.business.site, several searches). Dropped: Mahendra's Ahmedabad Branch (Bank PO/SSC coaching, part of the national Mahendra's chain, ad start 2026-10-25) and GMATclap (individual GMAT coach, not a multi-batch Gujarat institute).
report.worked: The actor ran cleanly (about 22-31 s per run) and returned full ad snapshots: page_name, page_id, start_date_formatted, is_active, snapshot.cta_type, snapshot.link_url, and the full ad body text with addresses and phones. Ad text itself is the best evidence of multiple branches (Edugreed lists three addresses with separate phones). Edugreed was found by three different queries (GSEB, coaching classes Ahmedabad, 11 12 commerce) and passed a quick own-site check. Surat query ('tuition classes Surat admission') returned a real Gujarat advertiser.
report.did_not_work: Yield was far below the plan (expected ~35-45 advertisers from 100 ads; got 5 advertisers, 9 ad rows). The Gujarati query, the transliteration 'admission chalu che tuition', 'GUJCET coaching admission', and the Vadodara, Rajkot and Gandhinagar/Mehsana queries all returned ADS_NOT_FOUND (6 of 10 query URLs empty). Long multi-word keyword phrases appear to match poorly in this actor, so the next round should try 1-2 word queries ('tuition classes', 'coaching classes', 'GUJCET', 'admission open') or Page-URL input instead; I did not try this, to respect the adapt-once rule. The WhatsApp link in ads usually has no phone (api.whatsapp.com/send only), so contact numbers come only from the ad text. Vadodara, Rajkot, Gandhinagar and Mehsana returned zero advertisers, so this source covers Ahmedabad and Surat only so far. Indeed and lyfskills pages returned HTTP 403, mathsci.business.site returned 404 (Google business sites are gone), and WebSearch found no website or listing at all for Oxford Education. report.worked: The directory is easy to mine: WebFetch on TargetStudy list pages with the 'flag repeated brands or shared phones' prompt reliably returns the table and the flags, and the recNo=0,20,40... pagination works. Branch mining then needs a cheap Maps check; scrapesage/google-maps-scraper costs about US$0.0024 per place with details and returns website, phone, review count, open status and a scrape timestamp, which is the best liveness proof. The best lead (Gyanjyot) came from a brand repeated 6 times in the lists, then confirmed by Maps (4 live pins) and its own contact page (7 branches, phones, email). TargetStudy profile pages (targetstudy.com/coaching/<id>/<slug>/) show a 'last updated' date and an 'Institute Website' field, found by asking WebFetch for the href on a list page.
report.did_not_work: 1) Directory rows alone prove nothing about 2026: profile pages show last-updated dates of 2015 to 2023 (Busy Education Mehsana 29-Sep-2015, Nandu Education Rajkot 31-May-2021, Edunova 13-Oct-2021, IIT Ashram 07-May-2021, Boson Academy 19-Jun-2023, Exodus Educare 20-May-2023). Many brands that look multi-branch there could not be found alive on Maps or on their own site, so I dropped them: Edunova (Maps shows only schools and a one-review academy, no coaching centre), Busy Education (5 cities in the directory, no Maps hit in Surat, 2015 profile), Alpha Science Academy (1-2 reviews, no site), Himanshu Patel Commerce Institute, Ketan Bhatt Coaching, Akshar Institute (no coaching match), Boson Academy, Exodus Educare Center, Nandu Education (no own site found). 2) WebSearch is US-only and returns mostly targetstudy.com and careers360 pages; it found no official site for most brands. Generic area queries ('our branches' tuition classes Surat/Rajkot/Vadodara) returned only schools and directories. DuckDuckGo html search returned a bot CAPTCHA and I did not try to get past it. 3) apify compass/crawler-google-places refuses runs below a US$0.50 cap, so it cannot be used inside a US$0.1 budget; use scrapesage/google-maps-scraper instead. 4) Chains hiding in the lists, now rejected: Mahesh Tutorials (about 190 centres), Nayak's Tutorials (Thane HQ, about 75 centres), Sinhal Classes (Mumbai HQ, 15 centres, franchise page), Bothra Classes (now PW Bothra), plus ALLEN, Aakash, Narayana, Career Point, Vidyamandir. 5) Already have a system, rejected: IIT Ashram Vadodara (student login, parent login, own mobile app, exams portal) and RJ Vision Vadodara (Android and iOS apps with schedule, attendance and results, student login, Nadiad centre too). 6) Gyandeep Classes Maninagar: own site shows one branch and an IT/BCA/MCA focus, so the 3-branch directory rows do not match it. 7) Name-prefix overlaps in the lists (Shah, Shree, Patel, Success, Prism, Raj, Navrang, Nilkanth, Master, Shreeji) are mostly unrelated businesses; do not chase them without a shared phone and a Maps pin. 8) Gandhinagar has only 2 and Mehsana only 1 row in the 9th-10th list, so these two cities need a different source (Maps or ads). 9) Yield was far below the plan: about 30 repeated-brand groups from roughly 1,500 rows gave one strong lead after liveness and own-site checks, not the 5-8 expected. Not yet done: Surat 9th-10th page 4, commerce pages beyond the first for Surat and Vadodara, Rajkot commerce, medical entrance, 6th-8th and CA lists.

per_source.note: Actor works but the yield is thin: only 5 advertisers (9 ad rows), 6 of 10 query URLs returned ADS_NOT_FOUND, and Vadodara, Rajkot, Gandhinagar and Mehsana gave nothing. Ad text is the best proof of branches and phones. Edugreed is a strong lead; Oxford is thin; Mathsci was dropped (single site, no phone, dead site). The collector already dropped Mahendra's (chain) and GMATclap (individual coach).

Best source for liveness: Maps open status plus own-site check gave Active English, Kishor and Achievers. The brand + nearby-city locationQuery trick works; brand-only queries are flaky (5 of 10 empty). Category searches in Gandhinagar and Mehsana are dominated by chains and competitive-exam franchises. 4 of 7 rows were dropped (PD Gurukul, Rudra, Shree Academy, Eagle Diamond). TargetStudy mining plus Maps liveness found Gyanjyot, the strongest lead overall, and Dhyey. About 30 repeated-brand groups from roughly 1,500 rows gave 1 strong lead because directory profiles are stale (2015-2023), many brands are chains (Mahesh Tutorials, Nayak's, Sinhal, Bothra/PW) or already have apps (IIT Ashram, RJ Vision). judged.replan_advice: Enough for round 1 (7 usable, 5 of them medium or high confidence), but coverage is lopsided: all 7 are in Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar and Mehsana, and there is nothing from Surat, Vadodara or Rajkot. If a second round runs: (1) Maps: run per-city category searches ('coaching classes', 'tuition classes', 'commerce classes', 'GUJCET coaching') for Surat, Vadodara and Rajkot with a larger maxPlacesPerSearch, then group results by brand name or shared phone to spot multi-pin brands. To check a known brand, always use brand plus a nearby-city locationQuery (this revealed Active English's whole family); brand-only and brand+home-city queries return empty about half the time. Do not reuse the seeds Bothra, Boson Academy, Eagle Classes Surat, Wisdom Academy, Prarambh (parent attendance app), Boson Physics (own app). (2) Meta Ad Library: long phrases fail; try 1-2 word queries ('tuition classes', 'coaching classes', 'GUJCET', 'admission open'), or feed page URLs. Expect only Ahmedabad and Surat advertisers, so do not count on it for Vadodara or Rajkot. (3) Directory mining: finish what was not done (Surat 9th-10th page 4, commerce pages beyond page 1 for Surat and Vadodara, Rajkot commerce, medical entrance, 6th-8th, CA lists, Gandhinagar and Mehsana need Maps instead), and always confirm a brand on Maps with a recent open status before keeping it, since profile dates are 2015-2023. Skip chains and already-systemised names found this round (Mahesh Tutorials, Nayak's, Sinhal, PW Bothra, ALLEN, Aakash, Narayana, Career Point, IIT Ashram, RJ Vision). (4) New signals not yet tried: Naukri/job posts for admission counsellor or branch manager at brands already found, and a Play Store disqualifier check. For the researcher: settle Kishor's KION/AppX scope, the Edugreed Naroda phone conflict and Hanspura/Bopal branches, Oxford's real existence and phone typo, and Dhyey's second and third branches. Ignore Active English's Kalol and Mansa branches for geography (the Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar and Mehsana branches qualify).

hypotheses: Admission enquiries across 7 branches are tracked by counsellors by phone and visit with no shared enquiry-to-admission-to-fee pipeline. This is inferred only from the absence of any online booking or portal on the admissions page.
Fee collection and instalment reminders are manual (registers or Excel) or sit in whatever software sends the SMS alerts. Nothing observed either way.
The SMS alerts probably run on some attendance or bulk-SMS tool. If that is the same local vendor as the school app (Microweb), the group already has an ERP vendor and resistance is higher.
A 2022 white-label app with about 10 installs for the Sola branch suggests an earlier trial that was not adopted network-wide. This is inferred and the ownership link is unconfirmed.

dossier.ability_to_pay: Structural, not financial. Seven branches in commercial premises (a retail-mall floor above Croma, Thaltej and Prahladnagar arcades), three branches independently seen operating on Google Maps with 4.2 to 4.7 ratings, a sister school paying a vendor for a parent app, and 90% scholarships (suggesting margin). dossier.resistance: Moderate. (1) A parent-communication system already exists: weekly test-result SMS and daily absentee alerts. (2) The same brand's school arm uses a Microweb Solutions parent app that covers attendance, homework and fee dues, and a 2022 Octopod/Studentink app exists for the Sola branch, so the owner knows school-ERP vendors. (3) No decision-maker contact is published beyond a generic Gmail and branch counsellor lines. (4) No anti-AI or anti-bot positioning seen. The web vendor is an agency, not an ERP, and holds no ERP lock-in.
dossier.best_angle: Do not pitch 'you have no parent updates', since SMS alerts already exist. Lead with multi-branch admission enquiry and follow-up: counsellors take enquiries by phone and visit across 7 branches, so offer one shared WhatsApp-first pipeline from enquiry to appointment to admission to fee follow-up. Open with a question about how the branches keep enquiries and fee dues consolidated today and which system sends their SMS, which also tests the resistance hypothesis.
dossier.best_channel: Email to the published business address (gyanjyot079@gmail.com), addressed to the Director, followed by a human phone call to the Bopal House line asking for management. No WhatsApp opt-in route exists (no wa.me link or WhatsApp-labelled number), so cold WhatsApp is not recommended.
dossier.case_for: Real, owner-led, 27+ year institute with 7 listed branches. Three branches are independently confirmed on Google Maps, and the founder-Director is named on the About page. Admission is entirely by call or visit to a branch, with no online booking, payment or portal. Batch-heavy (60+ batches of 15) and multi-location, which is the structural fit for one system across branches. Seven separate branch phone numbers suggest fragmented intake. Not a franchise or a reseller, and the web vendor is not an ERP.
dossier.case_against: The need is inferred, not observed: no page shows registers, Excel or WhatsApp-group handling or lost fees. Counter-evidence exists: parents already get test-result and absentee SMS, the group's school arm has a vendor-built parent app with fee-due alerts (updated Nov 2024), and a Sola branch app existed in 2022. The owner has no direct contact route, only a generic Gmail and branch phones. Most size claims (100+ teachers, 42 classrooms) come from the institute's own half-finished template site, which has 0 counters and conflicting years. Social presence is small (911 followers). This is a low B and would drop to C if a branch confirms the existing vendor already covers admissions and fees.

challenge.strongest_objection: The need is not observed anywhere, and the only direct evidence about how they run parent communication points the other way. They already send weekly test-result SMS and daily absentee SMS, which means attendance is captured digitally, and a sister school at the same address and the Sola app show a family of ed-tech purchases. Nothing public shows registers, Excel or lost fees. Under the grade rule, B needs either an observed need or strong pay and strong reach with an inferred need. Pay is only moderate (self-reported size on a template site) and reach is a generic Gmail plus branch phones with no direct route to the named Director. That makes this a real, well-fitting prospect with thin evidence, not a B.
corrections: Grade C, not B. Need is inferred, pay is moderate and reach is weak, so neither B condition is met.

What would earn B: (1) a published owner or Director contact, or a company or registry record showing who runs it. (2) Observed need, such as a review or ad that complains about fee follow-up, admission handling or slow replies, or one human call to a branch confirming enquiries and fees are tracked by hand. (3) Evidence of ad activity in the admission season (Meta Ad Library was not checked). (4) Finding out which system sends the SMS alerts. If it turns out to be a full coaching ERP, drop to reject for 'already has a solution'.

research.note: console_entry is only filled for leads that pass every check; the owner reviews them before a push.

fit.rationale_quality: Good and mostly specific to this need. The plan says up front that the need is latent, since nobody posts "I need institute software". It then chooses structural proxies (one brand at several addresses, shared phones) and behavioural proxies (a paid admission ad that opens WhatsApp, admission by Google Form, no portal). Each chosen source is tied to one of these. TargetStudy is used to expose branch structure, Maps to prove the business is alive and to fill the thin cities Gandhinagar and Mehsana, and the Meta Ad Library to show how enquiries are captured. The plan also lists disqualifiers specific to this vertical (ALLEN/Aakash/PW chains, Classplus/Teachmint/EduTask vendors, schools, individual home tutors, existing parent apps). The 10 rejected sources have concrete reasons, several backed by searches actually run (no Gujarat coaching register, no owners' association list, no news volume). The run reports are candid. They record the Meta shortfall (5 advertisers, 6 of 10 queries empty), stale directory profiles from 2015-2023, and chains and app-equipped brands removed (Mahesh, Nayak's, Sinhal, IIT Ashram, RJ Vision). Weaknesses: Maps plus Meta plus a directory is close to the usual local-business trio, so the need-specific part is mainly the branch-mining logic and the disqualifier checks. The plan's own fallback steps (cross-checking brand ads, review pain evidence) were never run. Surat, Vadodara and Rajkot got no real discovery.
suspicious_candidates: Oxford Education (rank 6): existence rests on one Facebook page with 31 likes and one ad. There is no website, Maps listing or directory entry. The call number and the WhatsApp number differ by one digit. The three localities may be one area, not branches. It may be a single tutor's mobile number, which the plan itself disqualifies. Treat as unverified.

Dhyey Institute / Dhyey Education (rank 7): the three directory rows share one mobile number (9825018985), which looks like one tutor listed at several addresses and not real branches. Only one Maps pin (Thaltej) is confirmed, there is no website, and the directory profile date was not checked. The multi-branch claim is unproven.

Kishor Institute (rank 4): the site mentions Android and iOS apps and a Play Store search found 'KISHOR INSTITUTE ONLINE - KION' by AppX Education. This may already be an existing parent/student system, which the plan treats as a disqualifier. Prarambh and Boson Physics were dropped for apps, so the standard is applied unevenly. Site and Maps phone numbers also do not match.

Achievers Commerce Academy (rank 5, mild): only 1 Maps pin is confirmed, the other branches are claimed on a 2024 site, and there is no email. It is medium confidence, so researcher verification is needed.
sources_that_should_have_been_considered: Meta Ad Library cross-check of the already-found multi-branch brands (Gyanjyot, Kishor, Active English, Achievers) by Page URL or brand name. This was in the plan's own fallback but not run. It would add the behavioural signal the top candidates lack, and would test whether the actor fails on long keyword phrases but works with 1-2 word queries or Page-URL input.

Per-city Maps category sweeps for Surat, Vadodara and Rajkot with a higher maxPlacesPerSearch. Run A covered only Gandhinagar and Mehsana, so the three big cities were left to a stale directory and flaky brand-name seeds. The collector flagged this gap itself.
Google review text mining on finalists for 'fees', 'attendance' and 'parents' (plan fallback 5). It is the cheapest direct evidence of manual-process pain and was not run.

Naukri job posts for admission counsellor, centre manager and accounts executive (plan fallback 1, about $0.04). The 7 survivors fell short of the plan's own 'fewer than about 8' fallback trigger, yet no fallback ran and no reason was given.

Gujarati newspaper admission ads and e-paper supplements (Divya Bhaskar, Sandesh, Gujarat Samachar), where local coaching classes advertise each season. It was not considered at all; usefulness is plausible but unverified.

Public web searches for admission pages built on Google Forms or wa.me links with Gujarati and English keywords. This directly targets the 'manual admission' signal, but WebSearch was reported US-only and weak.
Justdial or other directories for Vadodara and Rajkot only, as coverage fill where TargetStudy and Maps were thin. The plan rejected Justdial wholesale as overlapping Maps.

The final ranking labels confidence correctly (high for Gyanjyot and Active English, medium for Edugreed, Kishor and Achievers, low for Oxford and Dhyey). Unknowns are stated, including owner names and phone mismatches for Edugreed's Naroda branch and Kishor. Three softer points. (1) The judge summary says "enough: true" with 7 usable. The plan's own fallback trigger was fewer than about 8, and 2 of the 7 are low-confidence, so the honest number is about 3 solid plus 2 medium plus 2 doubtful, and the fallback was skipped without a stated reason.
