scrape.campaign: Custom ERP for small and mid-size manufacturers (Gujarat)
scrape.need: Small and mid-size manufacturers run orders, stock, production and dispatch on Excel and phone calls, with errors and delays, and are growing out of it

need_analysis.summary: Small and mid-size manufacturers (about 20 to 200 staff) in Gujarat run orders, stock, production and dispatch on Excel, Tally and phone calls. Errors and delays have started to hurt and the owner is feeling the pain. The need is structural and long-lasting, so old evidence of fit is acceptable. A recent, dated trace such as a job post, a hiring call or an expansion is what separates a unit that is ready to buy from one that is merely a manufacturer.
need_analysis.who_has_this_need: Owner-run or family-run manufacturing units of about 20 to 200 staff with many SKUs or make-to-order work. In these five clusters: Morbi (ceramic tiles, sanitaryware), Rajkot (engineering, castings, forging, pumps, diesel engine parts, machined components), Ahmedabad GIDC (Naroda, Vatva, Odhav, Sanand: plastics, chemicals, auto parts, packaging, engineering), Vadodara (fabrication, electrical, machinery) and Surat (textile processing, embroidery, packaging).
need_analysis.decision_maker: Owner, managing director or partner. In larger family units, the operations head, works manager or GM. The HR person who posts a job is not the buyer. The sales contact is the company's own published phone or email, not the recruiter.
observable_signals: Hiring for ERP executive, MIS executive, production planning (PPC), store or inventory executive, dispatch coordinator, or Tally/Excel data-entry roles at a manufacturer. A job description that says 'implement ERP', 'Excel MIS reports' or 'coordinate production with sales' is the strongest sign.
Job description mentions MS Excel or Tally for stock, production or dispatch and does not name SAP, Oracle or Dynamics. This means the unit is still on spreadsheets.
Growth markers: new plant or production line, capacity expansion, second unit, new GIDC plot, export start. Seen on the company site, trade-journal news or a job post for many roles at once.
Complexity markers: many SKUs, sizes or custom specifications on the company's own site or catalogue. These make Excel break down.
Listed on B2B marketplaces as a manufacturer with 11 to 250 employees and a turnover band. This gives fit, not need.
Employee reviews (AmbitionBox text that comes with the Naukri actor output) saying 'manual work', 'no system', 'everything on paper/Excel'. Use only as a supporting hint.
where_signals_show: Naukri.com job posts (company jobs, posted within 30 days)
Indeed India job posts (SMEs post directly here)
TradeIndia and IndiaMART manufacturer profiles (employees, turnover, GST, website)
The company's own website and careers page
Machinery and industry trade news: machinist.in, themachinemaker.com, packagingsouthasia.com
Exhibitor lists of Rajkot Machine Tools Show (25-28 Nov 2026), IFFE Expo Rajkot (11-13 Nov 2026), Tech Expo Gujarat (27-29 Nov 2026), Engiexpo Ahmedabad (19-21 Dec 2026). Lists not published yet.
disqualifiers: Traders, dealers, shops, distributors and wholesalers that do not manufacture
Very large or listed companies, and subsidiaries of big groups with an in-house IT team
Software vendors, ERP consultants, implementation partners, staffing agencies and freelancers. They post ERP jobs but sell what we sell.
Units that already run SAP, Oracle, Dynamics or a full ERP and show no sign of outgrowing it
Outside Rajkot, Morbi, Ahmedabad, Vadodara or Surat clusters
Under about 15 staff or over about 250 staff
Job or news evidence older than about 90 days when it is the only need signal
No verifiable existence: no site, no listing, no GST or address
Contact only through a personal profile or a guessed email or number

considered.source: Naukri.com job posts (ERP / MIS / PPC / store roles) via Apify valig/naukri-jobs-scraper
considered.signal_for_this_need: Strongest, dated trace. A manufacturer paying a salary for an ERP, MIS or planning role is feeling the pain now. The job description also shows whether it is Excel/Tally or SAP.
considered.reachability: Indirect. The job gives the company name, address and often websiteUrl. The company's own site gives the published phone and email. Do not use recruiter personal names.
considered.volume_in_geo: Estimate, not measured: roughly 150-300 live postings across the 5 cities for these keywords in 30 days, mostly Ahmedabad, Surat and Vadodara. Perhaps 20-30 percent are real manufacturers that pass the filters.
considered.risk: Many postings are from staffing firms, ERP vendors and large companies, so filter hard. Naukri ToS gray area for scraping, mitigated by using public listings only. Actor reliability depends on Naukri changes.
considered.why: Best match of need signal, date evidence and cost. Fields include createdDate, job url, company.websiteUrl, company.address and full description.

considered.source: Indeed India job posts via Apify kaix/indeed-scraper (fallback unfenced-group/indeed-in-scraper)
considered.signal_for_this_need: Same ERP / MIS / PPC hiring signal as Naukri on a second board. Small Gujarat units often post only on Indeed, so it adds companies Naukri misses.
considered.reachability: Output includes company.urls.website, company.size, company.addresses and dates.posted. Company site gives phone and email.
considered.volume_in_geo: Estimate: 100-250 postings in 30 days across the 5 cities for the keyword set; overlap with Naukri expected at 20-30 percent.
considered.risk: Indeed blocks unproxied requests (actor uses proxy). The actor has few ratings (7). The listed price is $0.00005 per job but the detailed mode price is not confirmed, so cap maxItems and watch run cost.
considered.why: Very cheap, adds SME coverage and company size. Gives a second dated job-post signal for cross-checking companies that appear on both boards.

considered.source: TradeIndia manufacturer / supplier profiles via Apify scrapesage/tradeindia-scraper (mode searchSuppliers)
considered.signal_for_this_need: Fit only: manufacturer flag, employee band, turnover, GST, year established, website, owner name. It is the best size filter for the 20 to 200 staff buyer profile, but it does not show the need by itself.
considered.reachability: Good. Profile has company website and address. The actor can crawl the seller's own site for emails and phones (extra $0.0034 per record, keep it off at first). TradeIndia hides phone behind login, so take contacts only from the company's own site.
considered.volume_in_geo: High: thousands of Gujarat manufacturer profiles. Estimate 30-40 percent have an employee band that fits.
considered.risk: Self-declared profile data can be stale or inflated. Small actor (35 users), so check output on a 5-record trial first. Needs a second proof of need before it becomes a candidate.
considered.why: Gives a size-qualified pool at about $0.0017 per record. Cross-matching it with job-post companies turns fit into fit plus need.

considered.source: IndiaMART manufacturer profiles via Apify sourabhbgp/indiamart-scraper
considered.signal_for_this_need: Fit only, same as TradeIndia: manufacturer filter, employee band, GST, CIN, named contact person, city.
considered.reachability: Good: phone, GST, website. Residential Indian proxy required (built in).
considered.volume_in_geo: Very high, especially Morbi and Rajkot.
considered.risk: Search mode returns product rows; the employee band needs a second pass in supplierProfile mode, so cost doubles. Residential proxy cost.
considered.why: Duplicates the TradeIndia pool and is costlier per qualified company. Keep as the first fallback if TradeIndia coverage is thin for Morbi or Rajkot.

chosen.name: Naukri job posts for ERP, MIS and production-planning roles at manufacturers
chosen.how_to_run: Actor valig/naukri-jobs-scraper (Apify id U5tcRMY1heBYd1FYF, $0.00036 per result plus $0.0009 per start). Read only its inputSchema before running. Run a matrix of 3 keyword strings x 5 cities = 15 runs, each with: {"keywords":"<K>","location":"<CITY>","sort":"f","jobAge":"30","jobPostType":["1"],"wfhType":["0"],"limit":14}. K = "ERP executive", "MIS executive", "production planning control". CITY = Rajkot, Morbi, Ahmedabad, Vadodara, Surat. For Morbi use ceramic-side extras if the first run is empty ("MIS executive ceramic", "store executive tiles"). jobPostType "1" removes consultant postings. Total at most 210 results, about $0.09. Then post-filter in this order: (1) reject company.name that looks like staffing, consulting, ERP or IT vendor; (2) require the description or industry to mention manufacturing words (plant, production, factory, shop floor, dispatch, store, fabrication); (3) reject if the description names SAP, Oracle or Dynamics as the existing system; (4) keep if createdDate is within the last 90 days; (5) mark positive if it mentions Excel, Tally, manual reports, 'implement ERP' or 'MIS'; (6) look at ambitionBox reviews text for 'manual', 'no system', 'excel' as supporting hint only. Then find the company's own website (company.websiteUrl, else a web search) and read its contact page with WebFetch. Never contact anyone.
chosen.qualifying_signal: A live or recent (within 90 days, from createdDate) job post by a company that manufactures in one of the 5 clusters, for an ERP / MIS / PPC / store / dispatch role, with no sign of SAP/Oracle, where the job description points to Excel, Tally or manual reporting or says the company is setting up ERP. Plus: the company is not a vendor or staffing firm, and is about 20 to 200 staff by its own site, a marketplace profile or the job's company data.
chosen.expected_yield: Estimate: 4 to 6 usable candidates from about 210 job rows. Expect most rows to be rejected as staffing firms, ERP vendors or large companies.
chosen.fields_to_capture: company name; company website; business-published phone and email with the URL where seen; city and cluster; job title; job URL; createdDate (evidence date); the exact words in the job description that show Excel/Tally/manual work or ERP setup; vacancy count; any AmbitionBox dislike text with its URL; industry and product line; size hint with source. Do not capture recruiter personal names.

chosen.name: Indeed India job posts for the same roles, to catch SMEs that skip Naukri
chosen.how_to_run: Actor kaix/indeed-scraper (id BIeK7ZcYUrdxDgOEQ, listed at $0.00005 per job plus $0.00001 per start; fallback unfenced-group/indeed-in-scraper at $0.00076 per job). Its README is huge, so call fetch-actor-details with output {"inputSchema":true} only. Run 3 keywords x 5 cities (15 runs): {"keyword":"<K>","location":"<CITY>, Gujarat","country":"IN","radius":"25","sort":"date","fromDays":"30","searchMode":"detailed","maxItems":20}. K = "ERP executive", "MIS executive", "production planning". Check the exact enum values for country, radius and searchMode in the schema before the first run. Cap maxItems at 20 and abort a run if its cost goes past $0.01, since the detailed-mode price is unconfirmed. Use the same post-filter as source 1. Use company.urls.website and company.size from the output. De-duplicate against Naukri by normalized company name; a company found on both boards is a priority candidate.
chosen.qualifying_signal: Same as the Naukri source: a dated job post (dates.posted within 90 days) by a manufacturer in the 5 clusters for an ERP, MIS, planning, store or dispatch role, with Excel/Tally/manual signs and no SAP/Oracle, from a company that is not a vendor or staffing firm.
chosen.expected_yield: Estimate: 2 to 4 usable candidates not already found on Naukri, from up to 300 job rows.
chosen.fields_to_capture: company name; company.urls.website; company.size; company addresses and city; job title; job URL; dates.posted; the phrases in the description that show the need; contacts only from the company's own site with the page URL; industry.

chosen.name: TradeIndia manufacturer profiles with 20 to 200 employees, cross-matched with job posts
chosen.how_to_run: Actor scrapesage/tradeindia-scraper (id GovFwbs82WVrvcOsH, $0.0017 per result, contact enrichment $0.0034 per record kept off at first). Run 6 small runs, each: {"mode":"searchSuppliers","searchKeywords":["<KW>"],"cities":["<CITY>"],"onlyManufacturers":true,"maxResults":8,"maxPages":1,"crawlSellerWebsite":false,"minLeadScore":30}. Pairs (CITY, KW): (Morbi, ceramic tiles), (Rajkot, engineering components), (Ahmedabad, plastic products), (Ahmedabad, chemicals), (Vadodara, fabrication works), (Surat, textile processing). That is 48 records, about $0.085. Run one 3-record trial first to confirm the fields exist. Post-filter: employee band between 26 and 250 (accept 11-25 only when turnover or site shows growth), business type includes Manufacturer, has a website, and the city is inside the geography. Then cross-match company names with sources 1 and 2. A pool company becomes a candidate only if it has a second proof: (a) a matching job post, (b) the company's own site or news shows expansion, a new unit or many SKUs or custom orders, or (c) the company's careers page lists ERP, MIS or planning roles. Otherwise tag it 'fit-only' and keep it out of the main list.
chosen.qualifying_signal: A TradeIndia profile showing a manufacturer in one of the 5 clusters with a 26 to 250 employee band, a website and a GST number, AND one second proof of need from a job post, expansion or complexity (many SKUs, custom orders) found on the company's own site or in news within the last 12 months.
chosen.expected_yield: Estimate: 48 profiles, about 15 pass the size filter, and 3 to 5 become candidates after the second proof. Fit-only leftovers are returned separately as a pool.
chosen.fields_to_capture: company name; seller profile URL; employee band; annual turnover; year established; GST number; business type; city and address; website; owner name only if it is in the business profile; phone and email only from the company's own website with the page URL; the second-proof URL and date.

plan_round1.if_low_yield: If fewer than about 8 usable candidates come out: (1) Widen jobAge to 60 days and add keywords: store executive tally, dispatch coordinator, inventory controller, data entry operator production, MRP, 'implementation of ERP', 'advanced excel' plus plant. Add Foundit (themineworks/foundit-jobs-scraper, $0.002 per job) and Apna (getascraper/apna-co-scraper, $0.00092 per job) for SME postings. (2) Replace or add IndiaMART (sourabhbgp/indiamart-scraper, businessTypes manufacturer, cities as above, then supplierProfile mode for the employee band) if TradeIndia is thin in Morbi or Rajkot. (3) Add Google Maps by estate with compass/crawler-google-places: search 'manufacturer' or 'factory' with locationQuery set to each estate (GIDC Naroda, GIDC Vatva, GIDC Odhav, GIDC Sanand, Makarpura Vadodara, Sachin or Pandesara Surat, Aji or Bhaktinagar Rajkot, Lalpar Morbi), website 'withWebsite', maxCrawledPlacesPerSearch 15, about $0.004 per place, then check each site for job and expansion signs. (4) Re-check exhibitor lists once published (IFFE Expo 11-13 Nov, Rajkot Machine Tools Show 25-28 Nov, Tech Expo Gujarat 27-29 Nov, Engiexpo Ahmedabad 19-21 Dec 2026) and run the same fit plus second-proof test. (5) Free news check on each shortlisted company in machinist.in, themachinemaker.com and city business pages for expansion within 12 months. (6) Prioritise any company that appears in two or more sources. (7) Check each association website directly (narodaassociation.org, Morbi Ceramic Association, Rajkot Engineering Association) for a public member page."

report.what_i_ran: Actor valig/naukri-jobs-scraper (U5tcRMY1heBYd1FYF), 19 runs, all with sort=f, jobAge=30, jobPostType=[1], wfhType=[0], callOptions maxTotalChargeUsd 0.1 and maxItems 40. (a) Planned matrix: 3 keywords (ERP executive, MIS executive, production planning control) x 5 cities (Rajkot, Morbi, Ahmedabad, Vadodara, Surat) = 15 runs, limit 14, 153 rows. (b) Two planned Morbi ceramic extras, 'MIS executive ceramic' (1 row) and 'store executive tiles' (0 rows). (c) Two extra runs for the dispatch-coordinator part of the signal, Rajkot (12 rows) and Ahmedabad (2 rows). Total 168 rows. Post-filter in order: staffing/ERP/IT vendors out, manufacturing words required, SAP/Oracle/Dynamics users out, createdDate within 90 days (all rows were within 30), positive flag for Excel/Tally/MIS/ERP text. Then pulled description.full for about 35 shortlisted rows, and used WebFetch/WebSearch on company sites, IndiaMART and directories to check identity, size and business-published contacts. Nobody was contacted; AmbitionBox and Naukri pages (403) were not bypassed.
report.worked: The actor itself is reliable and cheap, returns createdDate (epoch ms) plus createdDateText, vacancy count and company.address, and its PPC/production keyword queries return real plant jobs. Best yield came from 'production planning control' (Rajkot, Ahmedabad, Surat, Vadodara). Surat and Ahmedabad gave the best usable rows (Sarda Creations, Astek, Jindal Texofab). Own-website contact pages (sardacreations.com, jindalhome.com, astekelectricals.com, omvalcontrols.in, bansalpresses.com) gave business-published phone and email. description.full was needed to see Excel/MIS/ERP wording because description.short is often thin.
report.did_not_work: 1) Naukri keyword search is fuzzy. 'ERP executive' in Morbi returned mostly BPO customer-support jobs from other cities, 'MIS executive' in Rajkot returned logistics, banks and sales jobs, and 'dispatch coordinator' in Rajkot returned only non-Rajkot rows. Only about 1 row in 5 was a manufacturer in the right city. 2) Morbi ceramic SMEs essentially do not post on Naukri: the two ceramic-side extras gave one irrelevant medical-device row and nothing else; the only Morbi manufacturers were Asian Granito (listed) and Jetco Industries. Use TradeIndia/IndiaMART or exhibitor lists for Morbi. 3) company.websiteUrl is empty for about 90% of rows, so every site had to be found by search; several small firms have no web trace at all. 4) ERP-titled jobs were almost all IT vendors or staffing (Synoverge, Kahan, Dsoft, Squirrel Softech, A T E Enterprises on Dynamics 365) or a logistics-tech startup (Umbrella Protection Systems). No manufacturer posting says 'implement ERP'. report.what_i_ran: Actor kaix/indeed-scraper (BIeK7ZcYUrdxDgOEQ), searchMode detailed, country IN, radius 25 km, sort date, fromDays 14, maxItems 20, callOptions maxTotalChargeUsd 0.01 per run. Pass 1: 15 runs = keywords 'ERP executive', 'MIS executive', 'production planning' x Rajkot, Morbi, Ahmedabad, Vadodara, Surat (206 rows). Pass 2 (same signal, sharper words): 'ERP implementation manufacturing' and 'PPC executive' x Rajkot, Ahmedabad, Vadodara, Surat, plus 'ceramic tiles production store' for Morbi (42 rows). 248 job rows in total. I read the full job text of the manufacturer-looking rows with a small local script, then checked identity of the best ones with WebSearch/WebFetch (own sites, press release, IndiaMART/GST listings). Naukri cross-match was not possible because no Naukri output was passed to me. Nobody was contacted.
report.worked: The actor was fast (2-17 s per run) and cheap. Detailed mode gives the full job text, ISO posted dates, company phone/website/size when Indeed has them. Calling with waitSecs 0 and fetching the dataset afterwards avoids the huge field list that call-actor prints. The strongest evidence came from reading the job text itself (Excel/ERP/MRP wording, role mix) and then pairing it with a second public fact (press release, new plant, three posts in 10 days). JH-Welltec, Aditya Engimach and Girnar Machine came out of this and have own-site or press-release contacts.
report.did_not_work: 1) Input quirks: fromDays only accepts 1/3/7/14 (not 30), so I used 14; radius needs radiusUnit km. 2) Morbi is nearly empty on Indeed: 4 queries gave 1 row (Ishan Ceramic, a construction-chemicals plant manager for Agra/Morbi). Tile and sanitaryware units do not post here; use another channel for Morbi. 3) Keyword breadth: 'ERP executive' returns accountants, purchase, dispatch, sales and ERP-vendor BD jobs (Citta, Cybic, D'Soft, Emipro, Softhealer, Deloitte); 'MIS executive' returns car dealers (Nanavati Toyota, Navjivan Motors) and accounts; bare 'PPC executive' returns Google Ads/SEO jobs (13 of 15 in Ahmedabad); 'ERP implementation manufacturing' returned only 14 rows, mostly Deloitte Workday and Zydus. Use 'production planning and control', 'PPC engineer', 'store incharge', 'dispatch executive' instead, and do not repeat bare 'PPC executive'. 4) Data gaps: company.size and website are null for about 95% of rows and company.phone is always null, so identity needs web checks. These companies could not be verified online and were dropped: PAGBHAR Hygienic (Rajkot), Rational Engineers (Asoj), Kabra Global Products (search shows a Hyderabad firm), Diamond Factory (Surat), Maruti Exim (Surat), NHM Foods/Donzel (Kim), Shivashakti Group (Rakhial), Beaconworld Industries, VK Precious/Kohira (no clear fit). 5) Poster hides the employer: Nexora Consultants (Vadodara Por engineering roles), Prime Placement, Theindiajobs, Divyansh Manpower, Ever Best Job, Signature HR, UDG Hire Hub, Mudita Consulting, 'Jewellery Manufacturing' and 'Smart tech' (unnamed). 6) Too big (own site or data): Cambay Technopack Surat (650+ staff, USD 25M+; has an Excel-heavy Junior PPC post 2026-10-19, so worth a look only if the size cap is relaxed), Macpower CNC Machines Rajkot (4 lakh sq ft plant, 1000+ service engineers), Lubi Electronics (201-500 staff, SAP), Zydus, GE Vernova, L&T, Matrix Comsec, Amtech Electronics, Intas. 7) Already on an ERP: Jaynix Engineering, Indo Electricals, Columbia Machine (Infor M3), Globela Pharma, Bhumi Pharmaceuticals. 8) Signal strength: nearly every manufacturing job text mentions both Excel and ERP, so 'Excel + ERP' alone proves little; explicit 'manual', 'Excel only' or 'ERP is an advantage' wording was rare (JH-Welltec, G M Valve, Kadam). Treat these candidates as fit plus a dated hiring trace, not proof of pain. 9) Tool snags: kadamgroup.in gave an SSL error, the Hannover Messe exhibitor page returned 404, and directory sites disagree on staff counts (G M Engineering 51-100 vs 250; Filter Concept 11-25 vs 150).

report.what_i_ran: Actor scrapesage/tradeindia-scraper (searchSuppliers, onlyManufacturers, minLeadScore 30, no website crawl) in 7 small runs: 3-record Morbi trial (fields confirmed: employeesCount, annualTurnover, gstNumber, website, ownerName, businessTypes, yearEstablished all present), then Morbi ceramic tiles, Rajkot engineering components, Ahmedabad plastic products, Ahmedabad chemicals, Vadodara fabrication works, Surat textile processing. 52 records total. Post-filter: Manufacturer, own website, 5 clusters, 26-250 staff (11-25 only with growth sign). Second proof by WebFetch of each firm's own site (SKU count, custom orders, expansion, careers, ERP mentions, contacts) and by WebSearch for job posts, news and expansion. I could not cross-match with sources 1 and 2 because their outputs were not given to me.
report.worked: The actor ran clean and the fields exist. It gave GST, owner name, turnover and staff band for every record, so identity checks were easy. About 20 of 52 passed the size filter. Own-site fetches gave usable structural evidence (model/SKU counts, custom-order wording, plans for a new plant) and, for Mask Hydraulic only, direct emails and a dated blog. FIT-ONLY POOL (passed size/type filter but no second proof; do not contact yet): (1) Gravity Cast Pvt Ltd, Rajkot Shapar, 100 staff per TradeIndia, IndiaMART says 51-100 staff and Rs 5-25 Cr, casting plus forging, die casting, MIM and machining; no own site found, so it failed the website filter; strongest fit in the pool, researcher should look for a site; https://www.tradeindia.com/gravity-cast-pvt-ltd-1203708/ . (2) Wellmake Technocast Pvt Ltd, Rajkot, 100 staff, Rs 70 Million, IndiaMART lists 720 MT/yr; no own site; https://www.tradeindia.com/wellmake-technocast-pvt-ltd-1051412/ . (3) Hi-Tech Applicator, Vatva Ahmedabad, 110 staff (ZoomInfo says 27, RocketReach 55); Indeed company page (via search summary, undated, could not open, 403) lists Production Planning Engineer and IT roles, but search summaries disagreed on which roles exist, and its own site hitechapplicator.com says it 'operates on Integrated ERP System', so it likely has an ERP or SAP project; email hitech@ptfeindia.com on ptfelinedvalve.co.in; https://www.tradeindia.com/hi-tech-applicator-1738736/ . (4) Dhiren Plastic Industries, GIDC Naroda, 40 staff, est. 1985, Rs 3 Cr; search summary says Apna shows Store Keeper and Dispatch Manager roles (unverified, I could not find the URLs); the only URL seen is a WorkIndia Sales Co-ordinator post dated 2021-10-22 (stale); own site dhirenplasticcaps.com failed certificate check; https://www.tradeindia.com/dhiren-plastic-industries-2091307/ . (5) Gokul Poly Valves Pvt Ltd, Ahmedabad Bakrol, 100 staff, gokulpolyvalves.com failed certificate check, so unchecked. (6) Arihant Pack Plast, Ahmedabad Paldi office, 50 staff, about 48 SKUs, but the address is a business-hub office and it is flagged trader; likely a trader. (7) R. K. International, Morbi, 30 staff, rktile.in, 20 categories, flagged Trading Company and sits in a NH 8A showroom complex. (8) Daksh Prajapat Tiles Works, Morbi Thatithala, 40 staff, terracotta, 11 categories, no growth sign. (9) Linum Ceramic, Morbi, 25 staff, linumceramic.in failed certificate check; address is a showroom floor. (10) Aashi International, Morbi, 25 staff, est. 2022, shop address. (11) Satya Associates, Vadodara, 25 staff, flagged trader. (12) Emato International, Morbi, 18 staff. Out of band or rejected: Sonic Ceramic Pvt Ltd (300 staff), L-Tile Granito LLP (500), Aeron Composite Limited (Moraiya, Rs 250 Cr, Indeed calls it publicly listed, has IT/MIS/company-secretary roles), Labh Projects (export house/trader), Honestattva IT Solutions (IT vendor), plus about 20 records with fewer than 15 staff.
report.did_not_work: (1) No dated hiring or expansion signal was verified for any candidate. All second proofs are structural (SKU count, custom orders, plans) and undated, so every candidate except Mask is low confidence. Researcher should look for real job posts on Naukri/Indeed company pages by hand. (2) TradeIndia employee counts are self-declared and unreliable (examples: Gokul Poly Valves 100 staff with Rs 30 Lakh turnover; Kalapi 180 staff with Rs 2 Cr; Hi-Tech 110 vs 27 on ZoomInfo; L-Tile 500 with turnover 100000). Do not trust size without a second source. (3) Many Morbi 'manufacturers' on TradeIndia are NH 8A showroom or export offices that also trade; Ahmedabad 'plastic products' and 'chemicals' returned traders, an IT vendor and an export house; Surat 'textile processing' returned chemical and small engineering shops (all under 26 staff), not textile processors. Use a more specific keyword (for example 'embroidery', 'dyeing', 'sanitaryware') next time. (4) TradeIndia mini-sites carry no dates, no careers page and no email; their 080-45xxxxxx phone numbers are very likely marketplace-routed (inference from the 'Developed and Managed by Infocom Network' footer), so the firm's direct number is not known. Only Mask Hydraulic published real emails and direct mobiles. (5) WebFetch: Indeed, WorkIndia returned 403; dhirenplasticcaps.com, gokulpolyvalves.com and linumceramic.in failed certificate verification. WebSearch is US-only and its job-board summaries were inconsistent and undated, so job traces from it must be checked by hand. shine.com is blocked in WebSearch domain filters. (6) Company-name news searches for Clesso, Akshar and Vimal Forge expansion returned nothing. (7) Cross-match with sources 1 and 2 was not possible, so a hit there could upgrade Mask, Kalapi or Akshar. (8) I spent the full planned Apify budget on raw profiles, which gave fit but not need; a better use next time is fewer TradeIndia records and more effort on job-post sources.

judged.replan_advice: Not needed for count (13 usable, threshold 5), but only 8 have a dated need signal (ranks 1-8), and ranks 1-4 are clearly the best. For round 2 and the researcher: (1) Morbi has zero candidates and Vadodara has only fit-only ones. Naukri and Indeed do not reach Morbi ceramic units, so use exhibitor lists (Rajkot Machine Tools Show, IFFE Expo, Tech Expo Gujarat, Engiexpo) when they publish, plus trade-journal expansion news, GIDC or association member lists, and company career pages. (2) Fix the job queries: drop bare 'PPC executive' and 'ERP executive'; use 'production planning and control', 'PPC engineer', 'store incharge', 'dispatch executive', 'MIS executive manufacturing' with Excel or Tally in the text. Read full job text, since short summaries hide the Excel/ERP wording. (3) TradeIndia is a fit source, not a need source: use fewer records, more specific keywords (embroidery, dyeing, sanitaryware, die casting), and require a second size source and a dated signal before sending a candidate on. (4) Cross-match the sources: collectors worked blind to each other, so the researcher should check each lead on Naukri, Indeed and its own careers page. (5) Fit-only names the collector held back for lack of a website: Gravity Cast Pvt Ltd (Rajkot Shapar, about 100 staff) and Wellmake Technocast Pvt Ltd (Rajkot, about 100 staff). The researcher may look for their sites and hiring posts. Hi-Tech Applicator claims an Integrated ERP, so skip it. (6) Researcher priorities: confirm Jindal Texofab headcount and whether it is listed, confirm Astek is genuine (template-looking site), confirm G M Valve contact and ownership link to G M Engineering, confirm the Bansal post date, and check whether JH-Welltec is a foreign-group subsidiary with a parent ERP.

dossier.case_for: Real, verified, active manufacturer in Rajkot (site, Google Maps listing and Instagram all agree), 17 years old, two locations, with production, QC, warehousing and logistics departments, which is the right shape for an order/stock/production/dispatch system. The finder's own reading says an ERP already exists. No headcount, so the 20 to 200 staff fit is unconfirmed; about 10 standard models suggests modest production complexity. No decision-maker route beyond generic info@ and phones; no WhatsApp link published. Pay signal is thin and self-claimed. By the grade rule, an inferred need with a weak pay signal and only business-level reach is a C. It could move to B if a human opens the Indeed posts while logged in and sees dispatch or stock handled outside any system, and to A only if a named operations head and a real pay signal are also found.

fit.rationale_quality: Mostly specific to this need. The plan works out who has the pain (owner-run units of 20 to 200 staff in five named clusters) and which public trace separates ready to buy from merely a manufacturer: a dated ERP, MIS, PPC, store or dispatch job post with Excel or Tally wording and no SAP. It names concrete disqualifiers, such as ERP vendors and staffing firms posting ERP jobs, and the run reports proved this right. It also says honestly that marketplaces give fit but not need, and that fit-only rows need a second proof. The 15-source considered list has real checks behind it (GPCB, ZED and exhibitor-list dates were actually tried), not boilerplate. Weaker parts: the IndiaMART rejection (duplicates TradeIndia) and the Google Maps and Justdial rejections are generic cost-per-signal arguments. They did not weigh that Morbi is a named cluster and had no other route to it. The Gujarati-language local press, export-council directories, and SME IPO and rating filings were never weighed at all.
suspicious_candidates: Jindal Texofab Limited (rank 8): the 'Limited' suffix may mean a listed company, and directories disagree on headcount (3 vs 501-1000), so it may break the size ceiling. The signal is a back-office hiring role, not an operations or ERP role.

Astek Electricals India Pvt Ltd (rank 6): the site has template filler (five US offices, lorem ipsum), IndiaMART shows 11-25 staff, which is below the floor, and the 4 vacancies are unverified. Existence and size need a check before it is called a lead.

G M Valve Pvt Ltd (rank 7): no own website and no confirmed contact. The only phone belongs to a sister firm, G M Engineering, and the link between the two is unproven. The post says planning is kept in 'ERP/MRP', so a system already exists. Pay of Rs 14,000-20,000 points to a junior planner, not a buyer-level pain signal.

Swastik Engitech / Bansal Power Press (rank 10): the Naukri createdDate (2026-09-27) is probably a repost of a May 2026 job ID, with a single routine store-officer vacancy. The firm has two plants on about 7 acres and may be near or above the size ceiling.
Omval Controls (rank 5): the need is inferred from plant structure only. No Excel, Tally or ERP wording appears, and '5 vacancies' may be a bulk ad.

Sarda Creations (rank 3): '5 vacancies' for a PPC Manager at 0-5 years looks like a template or inflated ad. The candidate itself flags this, so it should not rank above stronger evidence without checking.

Mask Hydraulic Machineries, Akshar Precision Tubes, Kalapi Tractor Spares, Aarti Steel Enterprise (ranks 9, 11, 12, 13): all four are fit-only with no dated need signal. They should not sit in the main list under the plan's own rule. Kalapi's size and turnover figures also conflict (180 staff vs Rs 2 Cr), and the 080-45xxxxxx phones are likely marketplace-routed.
sources_that_should_have_been_considered: Apna, WorkIndia and Foundit as primary job sources, not only fallbacks. Small Gujarat units post store, dispatch and production roles there, and the TradeIndia run itself surfaced Dhiren Plastic's Apna and WorkIndia roles.

Export promotion council member directories (EEPC India, Plexconcil, Chemexcil, Texprocil, CAPEXIL), filtered to the five clusters. They are public, name real manufacturers with product lines, and exporter status is a complexity marker.

SME-listed company filings (NSE Emerge / BSE SME DRHP and RHP) and credit-rating rationales (CRISIL, ICRA, Acuite, Infomerics, CARE) for Gujarat MSME manufacturers. They give dated capex and expansion plans, working-capital strain and a headcount band, and sometimes mention ERP. They also cover the 'mid-size but not very large listed' band the exclusion rule allows.

Chamber and association directories fetched directly: SGCCI (Surat), RCCI (Rajkot), GCCI, and the Vatva, Naroda and Odhav associations. The plan says it searched and found nothing, but it lists checking each site directly only as a later step and never did it.

Gujarati-language local press and GIDC plot-allotment or new-unit notices (Divya Bhaskar, Sandesh, Gujarat Samachar business pages), for Morbi and Rajkot expansions. The English trade-news check only found listed or large companies.

For Morbi, IndiaMART or Google Maps by estate (Lalpar, Jetpar, Halvad), given Naukri and Indeed returned almost nothing for Morbi and TradeIndia returned showrooms and traders. Rejecting these was premature for a named cluster.
fit.notes:
Verdict: the source choice follows from the need. The job-post route is a real fit, but it is the standard India B2B stack (Naukri, Indeed, TradeIndia), so the lead list is thinner than the headline suggests.

Yield claim. The summary says 13 usable and enough: true, but that count is inflated.
- The plan's own rule says a marketplace row becomes a candidate only with a second proof of need, and otherwise stays 'fit-only' and out of the main list.
- TradeIndia found 8 and 4 are listed as usable, yet all four are fit-only and undated, and they sit at ranks 9, 11, 12 and 13.
- By the plan's definition the count is about 9, of which only 4 are medium confidence (Girnar, Aditya Engimach, Sarda, JH-Welltec) and 5 are low.
- The per-candidate text and the run reports are candid about the weak spots. The headline number and enough: true are the dishonest part.

Process gap. The plan's key logic for TradeIndia was to cross-match with Naukri and Indeed, and companies on two boards were to be priority candidates. The run reports show the three agents never received each other's outputs, so this step never ran. No company is confirmed on two sources. The cheapest fix is to run the cross-match before ranking.

Signal strength.
- The evidence is mostly 'hiring a planner or store person', which is routine and not proof of pain. The Indeed run found that nearly every manufacturing job text mentions both Excel and ERP.
- ERP-titled jobs were almost all vendors or staffing firms. No Naukri post mentions Tally. Review hints from AmbitionBox were never obtained.
- The two best leads are Aditya Engimach (Tally mandatory plus a dated 40% capacity expansion) and Girnar (three ops and dispatch posts in 10 days). Both have contacts published by the company and a named decision-maker route.
- Girnar already has some ERP, and its GM pay of Rs 70-100k suggests a smaller firm than the 'mid-size exporter' label.

Geographic coverage failed on two clusters, which the report says plainly. Morbi has zero candidates, because ceramic units do not post on Naukri or Indeed and TradeIndia returned showrooms and traders. Vadodara has only two fit-only entries. Rajkot, Ahmedabad and Surat carry the list.

Dates. All the job signals fall between 2026-09-27 and 2026-10-23, inside the 90-day window. Bansal's date is doubtful, as noted above.

Recommendation: demote or move the four fit-only rows to a separate pool, verify the five flagged candidates above before they reach a campaign, and add the missing sources above to a second pass, starting with Morbi.

Directory-only presence: Justdial or aggregator listing with a phone and no own site
Hiring a receptionist or telecaller for appointment calls (secondary: shows manual handling, not the web gap)
Patient reviews complaining the phone is not answered or appointments are hard to get (secondary, weak in past tests)
where_signals_show: Google Maps listing fields: website, phone, reviewsCount, imagesCount, ownerId, categoryName, permanentlyClosed
Meta Ad Library: page name, page category, ad body text, cta_type, link_url, start_date, is_active
Justdial listing page: phone, rating, review_count, photos_count, verified flag
Open web: WebSearch for '<clinic name> <locality>' shows whether any own domain exists; open the Maps website URL to see if it loads and is a real site
Job aggregators (WorkIndia, BapuTalk, Jobhai, Indeed): clinic receptionist posts, mostly Ahmedabad
disqualifiers: Hospital chains, large multi-speciality hospitals, nursing homes, branded chains and franchises (Clove, Sabka Dentist, Apollo, Zydus, Sterling, Shalby, HCG and similar)
Doctors who exist only as a Practo, Lybrate, DocIndia or Drlogy profile with no clinic of their own, or visiting consultants at a hospital
Clinics that already have a proper own-domain site with contact and booking
Agencies, freelancers, software vendors, competitors
Outside Mehsana, Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar (do not stretch to Kadi, Visnagar, Unjha)
Closed or temporarily closed places, no verifiable phone or listing URL, duplicates of a lead already found under another name
Evidence that cannot be re-read live (earlier rounds had 'no website' scout claims fail on re-check)
need_analysis.decision_maker: The doctor-owner of the clinic (BDS/MDS dentist, MD dermatologist, MS ophthalmologist or MPT physio). The name is usually in the clinic title ('Dr. X Dental Clinic') or on the listing.

considered.source: Google Maps listings via Apify (scraperlink/google-maps-scraper; fallback compass/crawler-google-places)
considered.signal_for_this_need: Strongest and most direct. The website field is public: empty means no site, a social or aggregator link means a weak site. Reviews and phone prove a real patient flow.
considered.volume_in_geo: High. Est. 100-200 relevant listings in Mehsana, 200-300 in Gandhinagar, thousands in Ahmedabad. Roughly a third show no or weak website, so about 60 raw candidates from 160 rows.
considered.reachability: Good. The phone is on the listing (27 of 30 no-website rows had a phone in our earlier Maps test). Email is rare.
considered.risk: Scraping Google is against its terms (data is public). Actor reliability is unproven for this actor: preflight 5 rows. The website field can be wrong, so every 'no website' must be re-checked live.
considered.why: Directly observes the need, high volume, cheap at $0.00045 per row, and the phone gives a business-published contact.

considered.source: Meta Ad Library via Apify (memo23/facebook-ads-library-scraper-ppe; fallback curious_coder/facebook-ads-library-scraper)
considered.signal_for_this_need: Strong pay signal. A clinic running active click-to-WhatsApp or Message ads whose link is wa.me, a Facebook page or Instagram is buying patients without an own website to catch them, which is exactly what the offer fixes.
considered.volume_in_geo: Medium. Ahmedabad has many clinic advertisers (dental and skin especially), Gandhinagar some, Mehsana few. Est. 30-60 distinct clinic pages across the three searches, of which 3-6 are independent with no own site.
considered.reachability: Good when the ad link is wa.me/<number> or a number is printed in the creative (published by the business in its own ad). Otherwise only the page name.
considered.risk: No city filter in the library, keyword search is noisy, chains and aesthetic franchises dominate, and the actor's free plan caps a run at 30 ads (if a run returns 30 or fewer, use the curious_coder fallback). Only business ads are read, no personal profiles.
considered.why: Best signal that the clinic spends money now. Past campaigns rated live Meta Ad Library cards as the best pay signal. It finds clinics Maps ranking would hide.

considered.source: Justdial listings via Apify (thirdwatch/justdial-business-scraper)
considered.signal_for_this_need: Moderate. Justdial is the main local directory for Gujarat small clinics, so a clinic present there with a phone, few photos and few reviews and no own site (to be checked) is a directory-only presence. The output has no website field, so the web check decides.
considered.volume_in_geo: Medium for Mehsana: 10 per category per page, several pages. Overlaps with Maps by an estimated half.
considered.reachability: Good. Phone is shown on the listing. No email.
considered.risk: Justdial forbids scraping and uses anti-bot (the actor needs the Indian residential proxy). Small user base (about 41 monthly users), last updated 1 Oct 2026. Run a 3-row preflight first.
considered.why: A different frame from Maps, a good phone source and covers small-town clinics. Dedupe by phone keeps the cost of overlap low.

considered.source: Practo / Lybrate / DocIndia / Drlogy / WhatClinic / Apollo 24x7 doctor directories
considered.signal_for_this_need: Weak. A doctor profile is not a clinic and says nothing about a website.
considered.volume_in_geo: High, but mostly person profiles and copies of Maps or Justdial data.
considered.reachability: Poor. A test search showed phone numbers hidden behind 'Show Phone Number'. Scraped copy sites (docindia, latrexa) are not business-published.
considered.risk: Many listings are exactly the 'listing platform only, no clinic of their own' case we must reject. Terms of service forbid scraping.
considered.why: No visible business-published contact and a high reject rate. Useful only as a cross-check for a clinic name.

considered.source: Statutory registers: NMC Indian Medical Register, Gujarat Medical Council, Gujarat State Dental Council; GPCB bio-medical waste authorisations
considered.signal_for_this_need: None. They prove a doctor or clinic exists, not that its online presence is weak.
considered.volume_in_geo: Large for the person registers; none found for private clinics from GPCB. A test search found no published GPCB list for private clinics in Mehsana, and an audit said only government facilities were registered.
considered.reachability: Poor. Registers give registration numbers and names, rarely a clinic address, phone or site.
considered.risk: Person-level data, captcha-gated search forms (not to be bypassed).
considered.why: No need signal and no usable contact. Not worth the effort for about 8 candidates.

considered.source: Job posts: WorkIndia, BapuTalk, Jobhai, Apna, Indeed (kaix/indeed-scraper at $0.00005 per job)
considered.signal_for_this_need: Weak to moderate. A clinic hiring a dental assistant or receptionist is growing and handling calls by hand, but it does not show a missing website.
considered.volume_in_geo: Ahmedabad has many posts (a test search found 7 clinics). None found for Mehsana or Gandhinagar.
considered.reachability: Medium. Phones appear on aggregator posts but they are re-posts, not always business-published.
considered.risk: Posts are often old copies on aggregator sites. Growing clinics usually already have a site.
considered.why: Wrong signal for this offer and no coverage outside Ahmedabad. Kept as a cheap backup in the low-yield plan, with the post date as dated evidence.

considered.source: News and launch lists (Divya Bhaskar, Gujarat Samachar, Sandesh, health trade news)
considered.signal_for_this_need: Strong in principle (new clinics need a site and a profile now) but very rare.
considered.volume_in_geo: Very low. A test search found no 2026 independent clinic opening in the three cities.
considered.reachability: Poor. Articles rarely carry the clinic's own phone.
considered.risk: Mostly hospital or government items.
considered.why: Almost no yield for the geography. Revisit with Gujarati-language queries only if other sources fail.

considered.source: Association member lists: IDA branches, IADVL Gujarat, Gujarat physiotherapy and ophthalmology societies
considered.signal_for_this_need: None by itself. A member list says nothing about the website.
considered.volume_in_geo: Medium, but often PDF or login-gated.
considered.reachability: Medium. Some list clinic phones.
considered.risk: Member data may be shared for members only, not for marketing.
considered.why: A name list, not a signal list. Could seed names for Maps lookups if needed.

considered.source: Instagram / Facebook / X profiles of clinics
considered.signal_for_this_need: Moderate in theory (a clinic that lives on Instagram only).
considered.volume_in_geo: High.
considered.reachability: Mixed.
considered.risk: Not allowed: no scraping of personal profiles on these platforms, and terms of service forbid it. Business ad activity is read via the Ad Library instead.
considered.why: Against the rules for this run.

considered.source: Reddit, Quora, Facebook groups, LinkedIn jobs (explicit-ask posts)
considered.signal_for_this_need: Explicit asks from Gujarat clinic owners for a website are almost absent.
considered.volume_in_geo: Near zero for Gujarat clinics. Our 15 Oct test of 9 sources: Reddit 1 of 26, Facebook groups 1 of 24, Quora 0 of 30, LinkedIn jobs 0 of 28 strong-intent rows.
considered.reachability: Poor.
considered.risk: Terms of service and wasted spend.
considered.why: Past tests showed explicit intent is rare. This campaign works from trace-based signals.

considered.source: Google review text complaints (phone not answered, hard to book)
considered.signal_for_this_need: Moderate: proves lost patients, but only for clinics already found.
considered.volume_in_geo: Low. A past Maps review scout got 200 places and 81 reviews with 0 complaints for about US$1.
considered.reachability: Same as Maps.
considered.risk: Low hit rate, review text is personal data of reviewers.
considered.why: Not a discovery source. Only the newest review date is used as 'clinic is live' evidence for the shortlist (inside the Maps plan).

considered.source: Event and exhibitor lists (dental or medical expos in Ahmedabad)
considered.signal_for_this_need: None. Exhibitors are vendors and not clinics.
considered.volume_in_geo: Low.
considered.reachability: Medium.
considered.risk: Mostly competitors or suppliers.
considered.why: Wrong side of the market.

considered.source: IndiaMART / Sulekha / general B2B marketplaces
considered.signal_for_this_need: Low. IndiaMART is for manufacturers. Sulekha has few clinics.
considered.volume_in_geo: Low for clinics.
considered.reachability: Medium.
considered.risk: Wrong audience.
considered.why: Not where clinics leave a trace.

considered.source: Google SERP / domain checks (does '<clinic> <city>' find an own domain; MX or HTTP probe)
considered.signal_for_this_need: Good for verification, poor for discovery.
considered.volume_in_geo: Unbounded but no list to start from.
considered.reachability: Depends on the page found.
considered.risk: WebSearch quota is shared and limited. Earlier rounds had domain probes mostly hit namesakes.
considered.why: Used inside the chosen plans as the live 'no own website' check, not as a source.

chosen.name: Google Maps clinics with no or weak website (Mehsana, Gandhinagar, Ahmedabad outer ring)
chosen.how_to_run:
Preflight: confirm Apify credit is not blocked (earlier monthly cap was hit 15 Oct). Test run of scraperlink/google-maps-scraper with {"query":["dental clinic in Mehsana"],"location":"Mehsana, Gujarat, India","num":5,"gl":"in","hl":"en"} and check rows have title, phone, website, reviewsCount, imagesCount, categoryName, permanentlyClosed, googleMapsUrl. If fields are blank, switch to fallback compass/crawler-google-places with {"searchStringsArray":[...],"locationQuery":"Mehsana, Gujarat, India","maxCrawledPlacesPerSearch":20,"website":"withoutWebsite","skipClosedPlaces":true,"language":"en","countryCode":"in"} at about US$0.004 per returned place.
Main runs (actor scraperlink/google-maps-scraper, US$0.00045 per row + US$0.00005 start, no details/reviews/images):
Run A Mehsana: {"query":["dental clinic in Mehsana","skin clinic in Mehsana","eye clinic in Mehsana","physiotherapy clinic in Mehsana"],"location":"Mehsana, Gujarat, India","num":20,"gl":"in","hl":"en"} (up to 80 rows, about US$0.036).
Run B Gandhinagar: queries dental, skin, physiotherapy 'in Gandhinagar', location 'Gandhinagar, Gujarat, India', num 15 (up to 45 rows, about US$0.020).
Run C Ahmedabad outer ring, where weak profiles hide because central results are saturated with sites: ["dental clinic in Naroda, Ahmedabad","dental clinic in Nikol, Ahmedabad","skin clinic in Maninagar, Ahmedabad"], location 'Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India', num 12 (up to 36 rows, about US$0.016).
Script (no LLM) on the rows: drop permanentlyClosed or temporarilyClosed; drop rows without phone; drop chain or hospital names (regex: hospital, multispeciality, multi speciality, nursing home, apollo, zydus, sterling, shalby, hcg, cims, clove, sabka, dentzz, franchise); keep categoryName matching dentist, dental, dermatolog, skin, eye, ophthalm, physio, clinic; keep reviewsCount 8 to 300 (live patient flow, not a flagship); keep address inside Mehsana, Ahmedabad or Gandhinagar; classify website: empty = NONE; host in {facebook.com, instagram.com, practo.com, justdial.com, lybrate.com, linktr.ee, wa.me, business.site, blogspot.com, wixsite.com, weebly.com, godaddysites.com, sites.google.com} = WEAK; any other domain = HAS_SITE and dropped unless the site does not load or is a one-page parked/template page (open it with WebFetch). Dedupe by last 10 digits of phone. Rank: NONE first, then WEAK, then more reviews, missing ownerId, imagesCount under 10.
Live verification on the top 15 (scout duty, because earlier 'no website' claims failed on re-read): WebSearch '<clinic name> <locality> <city>' and open the Maps URL. Accept 'no proper website' only if no own domain turns up in the results; record what was seen, with the URL. Never use truncated page text as proof of absence.
Phase 2 on the shortlist of at most 12: same actor with startUrls (the googleMapsUrl values), reviews true, maxReviews 1, reviewsSort newest, placeDetails true (about US$0.011) to get the newest review date as 'clinic is active' evidence (accept a review within about 180 days).
Total about US$0.09.
chosen.qualifying_signal: Independent clinic in the three cities, open, with a Google-listed phone and 8 to 300 reviews, AND the Maps website field is empty or only a social, aggregator, dead or free-builder link, AND a live check finds no own-domain site (or only a one-page parked or template site). Evidence = Maps URL, the website value seen, scrape date 2026-10-26, newest review date. Not a hospital, chain or doctor-only profile.
chosen.expected_yield: About 160 rows scraped, about 60 with no or weak website, about 25 after filters, about 5 usable after live verification.
chosen.fields_to_capture: clinic name, doctor-owner name (from title), specialty, locality and city, full address, phone (Maps listing), googleMapsUrl, website value seen, website class (NONE/WEAK/HAS_SITE), reviewsCount, rating, imagesCount, ownerId present yes/no, newest review date, categoryName, verification note with the URL checked, scrape date

chosen.name: Meta Ad Library clinic advertisers sending patients to WhatsApp or a Facebook page, with no own site
chosen.how_to_run:
Actor memo23/facebook-ads-library-scraper-ppe (US$0.005 start + US$0.00045 per ad). Do NOT enable enrichEmails, includeAdReach or includeTotalActiveAds (extra charges). Three separate runs so one search cannot eat the whole cap; each uses searchCountries ["IN"], adActiveStatus "active", mediaType "all", filterDuplicatePageIds true, sortBy "most_recent":
Run A: searchTerms ["Mehsana"], maxItems 60 (all active Indian ads that mention Mehsana; clinics are picked out afterwards by page category and text), about US$0.032.
Run B: searchTerms ["Gandhinagar clinic"], maxItems 40, about US$0.023.
Run C: searchTerms ["dental clinic Ahmedabad"], maxItems 50, about US$0.0275. If the first 10 rows of any run are off-topic, rerun with searchMode "keyword_exact_phrase" and a phrase such as 'dental clinic in Ahmedabad'. If a run returns exactly 30 ads or fewer, the account is on the free cap: use the fallback curious_coder/facebook-ads-library-scraper with urls = Ad Library search URLs (country=IN, active_status=active, q=<term>, search_type=keyword_unordered), limitPerSource 50 (US$0.00075 per ad).
Script filter: is_active true; snapshot.page_categories or the ad body names a clinic type (clinic, dental, dentist, skin, laser, eye, physio, doctor, ortho); ad body, caption or page mentions Mehsana, Gandhinagar, Ahmedabad or a known locality; page_like_count under 50000; name not a chain or hospital. Funnel test: snapshot.cta_type in {WHATSAPP_MESSAGE, MESSAGE_PAGE, SEND_MESSAGE, CALL_NOW, BOOK_NOW, LEARN_MORE} AND link_url (also cards[].link_url) host in {wa.me, api.whatsapp.com, facebook.com, fb.me, m.me, instagram.com, linktr.ee, forms.gle, docs.google.com/forms}, a tel: link, or empty. An own-domain link goes to a WebFetch check: drop if it is a full site, keep as WEAK if it is a one-page or dead site. Group by page_id.
Contact = only the wa.me number in the ad link or a phone printed in the creative, cited with the ad URL https://www.facebook.com/ads/library/?id=<ad_archive_id>. Never guess or search for a private number. Open the Maps listing of each survivor with WebSearch to confirm the clinic is real and independent and to check for an own site.
Total about US$0.083.
chosen.qualifying_signal: Independent clinic page with an ACTIVE Meta ad (is_active true on 2026-10-26, start_date recorded) that sends patients to WhatsApp, Messenger, a Facebook or Instagram page or a form instead of an own website, in or around the three cities, with a business-published number or a page that has one. Evidence = Ad Library URL, cta_type, link_url, start_date, plus a live check that no own-domain site exists.
chosen.expected_yield: About 150 ads, 30 to 60 distinct clinic pages, 5 to 10 independent funnel-without-site pages, about 2 to 3 usable after verification.
chosen.fields_to_capture: page name, page_id, ad_archive_id and ad URL, page_categories, ad body excerpt, cta_type, link_url, start_date, is_active, city or locality seen, page_like_count, phone or wa.me number as published in the ad (with the ad URL), site check result with URL, scrape date

chosen.name: Justdial clinic listings in Mehsana, cross-checked for own site
chosen.how_to_run:
Preflight: thirdwatch/justdial-business-scraper with {"queries":["Dentists"],"city":"Mehsana","maxResultsPerQuery":3} (about US$0.006) to prove it is not blocked and returns phone, listing_url, review_count, photos_count, verified. If it returns zero rows or blocked, mark the source failed, spend nothing more, and use the low-yield plan.
Main run: {"queries":["Dentists","Dermatologists","Eye Specialists","Physiotherapists"],"city":"Mehsana","maxResultsPerQuery":10} with the default Indian residential proxy (US$0.002 per result, up to 40 rows, about US$0.08). Gandhinagar and Ahmedabad are left to the other two sources.
Script: keep rows with listing_url and a phone; drop business_name matching hospital, multispeciality, nursing home or chain words; keep review_count 3 or more. Dedupe against the Maps rows by the last 10 digits of the phone: a match merges and adds a second source to that Maps candidate. Remaining rows (expected 10 to 20): WebSearch '<business_name> Mehsana' and open the first results; qualify only if no own-domain site is found (a Facebook, Practo or Justdial page only is fine). Rank by few photos (photos_count under about 8), verified false, small review_count (thin listing).
Justdial has no website field in this actor output, so 'no website' is NEVER taken from Justdial; it comes only from the live check. Contact = the phone on the Justdial listing, cited with listing_url.
chosen.qualifying_signal: Independent clinic in Mehsana with a Justdial listing (phone published there) and a live check that finds no own-domain site. Evidence = Justdial listing_url, review_count, photos_count, scrape date 2026-10-26, and the web check note with the URL.
chosen.expected_yield: About 40 listings, half already in the Maps set, about 15 new, about 2 usable after the live check.
chosen.fields_to_capture: business_name, category, area, address, phone (as listed), listing_url, rating, review_count, photos_count, verified flag, overlap with Maps (yes/no), web check note with URL, scrape date

plan_round1.if_low_yield: Ladder, cheapest first, total extra spend capped at about US$0.15. (1) If Maps gives fewer than 5 verified: swap to compass/crawler-google-places with website \"withoutWebsite\" and skipClosedPlaces true (about US$0.004 per returned place, so about 25 guaranteed no-site rows for US$0.10), add specialties (ENT, orthopaedic, paediatric, gynaecology, homeopathy and ayurveda clinics, diagnostic centres) and more Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar localities (Bopal, Chandkheda, Vastral, Odhav, Sector 11/21/22/26), and rerun with hl \"gu\" and Gujarati terms. (2) If the Ad Library gives under 2: add terms 'WhatsApp appointment dental', 'skin laser clinic Ahmedabad', 'physiotherapy Ahmedabad', and Gujarati terms for Mehsana and Gandhinagar; drop the dateless pages. (3) Backup free source for dated evidence: WebSearch and WebFetch on WorkIndia, BapuTalk and Jobhai for 'receptionist / dental assistant' posts in Mehsana and Gandhinagar, then check each clinic for a website (low fit, last resort). (4) Revisit near-misses marked WEAK (one-page or dead sites) before searching new sources. (5) If Apify credit is blocked (monthly cap hit 15 Oct): run a free route only, using WebSearch and WebFetch on whatclinic, docindia, drlogy and latrexa clinic pages to get names and addresses, then confirm phone and absence of an own site; expect 3 candidates or fewer and say so. (6) Last step: ask the owner for a small Apify top-up (about US$5) rather than spending more tokens.

report.what_i_ran: Preflight test of scraperlink/google-maps-scraper (dental clinic in Mehsana, num 10; num 5 was rejected because the schema minimum is 10): fields came back populated (title, phone, website, reviewsCount, categoryName, closed flags, address, placeId). Then Run A Mehsana (dental, skin, eye, physio; num 20; 80 rows), Run B Gandhinagar (dental, skin, physio; num 15; 45 rows), Run C Ahmedabad outer ring (Naroda dental, Nikol dental, Maninagar skin; num 12; 36 rows). I set per-run maxTotalChargeUsd below 0.1 (0.04, 0.022, 0.018, 0.015) so the sum stayed under the US$0.10 cap. Filtering was done by reading the rows (no LLM script): dropped no-phone rows, chains and hospitals, rows under 8 or over 300 reviews, and any row with an own-domain site. That left roughly 60 clinics with an empty or weak website field (counted by eye). Phase 2: same actor with placeIds (instead of startUrls), placeDetails true, reviews true, maxReviews 1, reviewsSort newest, for 12 shortlisted places. That second read re-confirmed the website field and gave the newest review date. Live checks: 5 WebSearch calls (Uma Dental, Geeta Dental, Skin Sure and Bliss Dental done; one Ahmedabad query was refused), after which the shared per-turn web-search budget was exhausted and 6 further searches were refused. WebFetch was used on the Latrexa directory page for Uma Dental and on the Goradwala Wix page.
report.worked: Maps scraper returns clean title, phone, website, reviewsCount, categoryName and placeId at about US$0.00045 per row; the empty website field is plentiful in Mehsana and Gandhinagar (about a third to a half of dental, skin and physio rows with a phone). Re-reading the same places with placeDetails gave a second independent read of the website field plus a dated newest review (fresh reviews 21 to 25 Oct 2026 for six of them), which is cheap proof that the clinic is active (about US$0.00095 per place). Mehsana and Gandhinagar yielded more NONE-website clinics than the Ahmedabad outer ring (Naroda and Nikol dental mostly have sites, grexa.site or vercel.app template pages, or Justdial/Instagram links). Leftover unverified NONE/WEAK pool for a later round (not phase-2 checked, so no review-date evidence): Mehsana: Mayur Dental (63 reviews, +91 94270 15408), Ronak Dental (64), Shivam Dental and Implant (68), Ambika Skin Hair Laser (105), Aavakar physio (128), Jay physio (165), Dr Rahul Prajapati MPT physio (137); Gandhinagar: Shivam Dental Sector 22 (144), Star Advance physio (120), Shree Healthcare physio (200), Gayatri physio (110); Ahmedabad: Swastik Dental Naroda (57 and 20 reviews as two duplicate listings, same phone, a sign of messy Google profile), Smile Dental Care Nikol (48), Shrey Aesthetica Nikol (36), Dr Namrata Skin Maninagar (13), Shreeji Skin Care Maninagar (onefront.me link, 85), Radhe Dental Care Nikol (vercel.app page, 60). Estimated Apify spend: test US$0.0046, Run A US$0.0361, Run B US$0.0203, Run C US$0.0162, Phase 2 US$0.0114, total about US$0.089 (computed from published per-event prices; the run objects did not return a billed amount).
report.did_not_work: 1) Planned test input num 5 fails validation (minimum 10). 2) In basic mode the scraper's imagesCount is 1 for every row and ownerId is filled for every row, and claimThisBusinessUrl came back filled for 11 of 12 detailed places, so none of these separate unclaimed or thin profiles from managed ones; do not use them as signals (imagesCount became 5 to 6 only in detail mode). 3) WebSearch is weak for small Gujarat clinics: it mostly returns directories (whatclinic, docindia, latrexa) or unrelated clinics, and for Geeta Dental, Skin Sure and Bliss it returned nothing about the clinic at all, so it cannot prove absence of a site. 4) The shared per-turn WebSearch budget (200) ran out after 4 of my searches, so the live web check was NOT done for Shubham, Shekhat, Mehsana Dental, Goradwala (only the Wix page was fetched), Vedant, EVA and Prism; their NONE status rests on the Maps field read twice on 2026-10-26. I did not work around the limit. 5) DuckDuckGo HTML via WebFetch hit a bot check (not bypassed); Google Maps place URLs via WebFetch return only the text 'Google Maps' (JS page), so they cannot be used to re-read a listing. 6) Mehta Physiotherapy (Mehsana, 174 reviews, no website) was dropped because its newest review is 2025-12-25 (about 10 months old) and its description claims 10+ physiotherapists (likely bigger than a small owner clinic). 7) Mehsana eye places were mostly named hospital or had under 8 reviews (Maitri, Vishw, Synergy and others are hospital-scale or have sites), so only one eye clinic made the list. 8) Rows over 300 reviews with no or weak website (for example Dr Rajesh Desai Shreeji Dental 451 on a wa.me link, Krishna Dental Naroda 614, Dr Dhruv's Yashdeep Skin 574, Skin and Spine Clinic 1,624) were dropped by the 8 to 300 rule; they may be good leads if the rule is relaxed. 9) Clinic names containing 'hospital' (Dev Drashti, Ambika Eye, Retina Care, Krishna Eye, Smile Square, Neer Dental) were dropped by the chain/hospital regex even though some are single-doctor practices; a human could re-admit them. 10) Every shortlisted phone and Maps URL is public Google Business Profile data only; no email was found published for any candidate, so outreach will have to be by phone or WhatsApp.

apify_runs.actor: scraperlink/google-maps-scraper (Run C Ahmedabad outer ring, 3 queries)
scraperlink/google-maps-scraper (Phase 2 placeIds with details, 1 newest review each)

report.what_i_ran: Three memo23/facebook-ads-library-scraper-ppe runs (searchCountries IN, active, most_recent, filterDuplicatePageIds): A 'Mehsana' (34 pages), B 'Gandhinagar clinic' (16 pages), C 'dental clinic Ahmedabad' (25 pages). Triaged by ad text and CTA, then verified each survivor with scrapesage/google-maps-scraper (Maps website field, phone, rating, claimed owner) and, for vendor-hosted sites, curl on the clinic's own URL. About 14 small Maps runs, 21 places billed.
report.worked: Run C gave about 20 clinic pages and Run B about 8, so city-plus-'clinic' keywords beat a bare city name. The decisive verification was scrapesage with a generic category query ('dental clinic', 'dentist'), a locality in locationQuery, countryCode 'in' and nameQuery set to the distinctive clinic name: filtered-out places are not billed, so it costs about US$0.0014 per match. Ad phone numbers matched the Maps phone for 7 of 8 verified clinics, which confirms identity. Result: 8 verified candidates (3 with no website at all, 3 with a free or vendor subdomain, 2 other weak) plus 2 unverified low-confidence ones.

Zero usable Mehsana clinic leads from Meta ads. 2) snapshot.page_categories came back empty in the output, so category filtering must use ad text. 3) WebSearch was refused for the whole session (shared 200-call budget exhausted), so no 'clinic name + locality' own-site checks were possible; I did not work around it. 4) Facebook Ad Library URLs return 403 to WebFetch, so ads cannot be re-read live (status relies on the scraper's is_active on 2026-10-26). 5) compass/crawler-google-places refuses any run capped below US$0.50 and scraperlink needs num>=10, so both were unusable under the cap. 6) scrapesage with long full-name queries and no countryCode returned only 3 of 13 places and 0 for several; it only worked with category query + locality + countryCode 'in' + nameQuery. 7) Maps found no listing for MedixGlam, Dr Parikh's Pristine Dental (ad gives no locality, dropped) or Dr Rohit Damor's own centre. 8) WebFetch on a Flutter single-page site returned only the title; curl on the clinic's own URL was needed. report.what_i_ran: 1) Preflight: thirdwatch/justdial-business-scraper {queries:[Dentists], city:Mehsana, maxResultsPerQuery:3}. It returned 3 rows with phone, listing_url, review_count, photos_count and verified, so it is not blocked. 2) Main: same actor with queries Dentists, Dermatologists, Eye Specialists, Physiotherapists, city Mehsana, max 10 each, default Indian residential proxy. It returned 40 rows. 3) Filter by hand: kept rows with a phone, drop hospital/multispeciality/chain names, drop non-Mehsana towns, drop duplicates. 4) Attempted the live own-site check with WebSearch (6 parallel searches) and direct WebFetch of three Justdial listing URLs. Both failed, so NO candidate has been checked for an own-domain site.
report.worked: The actor works and is not blocked: it returns phone, listing_url, review_count, photos_count and verified for Mehsana. Billing was as listed (US$0.002 per row). It gives the 8 candidates above with listing URLs and a scrape date of 2026-10-26. Fields available are enough to rank thin listings.
report.did_not_work: (1) THE KEY CHECK FAILED. The WebSearch budget for the run was already used up (shared across agents, 200 per turn), so all 6 searches returned 'not performed'. I did not work around it with other search engines, readers or proxies. Result: no candidate has been verified as having NO own site. Treat every candidate as unverified, and the researcher must do the live check first. (2) Justdial blocks direct WebFetch with HTTP 403 on listing pages (tested on 3 listings), so listing pages cannot be re-read this way. I did not try to bypass the block. (3) I did not do the 'adapt once' step: only about US$0.014 was left in the source budget, enough for roughly 6 rows, not useful. (4) The Maps-overlap dedupe could not be done because I do not hold the Maps rows; use the last-10-digit phone keys given per candidate. (5) Data quality: the 40 rows contain only about 34 unique listings (Sai Krishna Hospital x3, Lions General Hospital x3, Vasant Prabha x2, Dr J M Mehta x2 repeated), so about US$0.012 was paid for duplicates. The Dermatologists and Eye Specialists queries mostly returned hospitals, general physicians, gynae and Ayurved results (Justdial fallback matches), and only about 8 true independent clinics surfaced. Rows outside the geography were also returned: Kadi (Aashirwad Dental, Skin & Shine), Visnagar (Gurujyot Skin, Aakash Eye, Jyoti, Drashti), Unjha (Dr Roma Patel), Ahmedabad Paldi (Eyevista) and Jalgaon (Lifeline, Maharashtra). Dr Batra's Healthcare is a national chain and was rejected. (6) IMPORTANT PATTERN: nearly every verified=false listing has an EMPTY phone in the actor output, and these unclaimed listings are the thinnest ones, the best fit for the need. My filter dropped them for lack of a contact route. Reserve list of independent Mehsana clinics with no phone in the data (need a business-published contact from another source before they can count): Shubham Skin and Laser Clinic (Dr Jemish Patel, Nagalpur, 64 reviews, only 5 photos, https://www.justdial.com/Mehsana/Dr-Jemish-Patel-Shubham-Skin-and-Laser-Clinic-Opposite-Umiya-Societynear-Radhanpur-Circle-To-Gopinala-Nagalpur/9999P2762-2762-190529162317-U5E8_BZDET), Eva Skin Hair And Laser Clinic (Radhanpur Circle, 85 reviews, 23 photos), Savita Multi Speciality Dental Clinic (457 reviews, 19 photos, dropped by the 'multispeciality' name rule although it is a dental clinic), Complete Care physiotherapy (Radhanpur Chokdi, 241 reviews, 39 photos) and Mehta Physiotherapy Clinic (Gopi Nala, 179 reviews, 88 photos). Hospital-named but possibly independent, dropped by the name rule: Vishw Eye Hospital (502 reviews, phone 8460508144) and Maitri Eye Hospital (1500 reviews). (7) Lesson for the next round: this Justdial source gives a good list of live local clinics with phones but cannot by itself show the weak-presence signal. It needs a working live-check step (a search budget reserved for it, or the Maps website field from the other source), otherwise its output is only a directory.

Against that: only one ad found, library end date 2026-10-25, the Facebook page has 5 likes, the clinic is about 1 year old, and no staff or branch scale is published. dossier.case_for: Verified real, independent, owner-led clinic in the right city (Ahmedabad). Dr. Gunjan Thakur is named, and the clinic publishes a WhatsApp/phone number, a second phone and an email. It is spending on a click-to-WhatsApp ad right now (anniversary offer till 31 Oct), so WhatsApp is its chosen lead channel and there is a plausible, still-unproven gap in instant after-hours auto-replies. It already has a professional site with SEO pages and a WhatsApp booking button, and a well-reviewed, claimed Google profile, so 'no website / weak presence' is false and the finder's evidence rested on an unchecked 'no website on Maps'. The only remaining need (auto-answered WhatsApp) is purely inferred, with no evidence of slow or manual replies. Pay signal is one short-lived ad and a 5-like page. It may have a site vendor. dossier.best_angle: Do not lead with a website or 'no website' (false). fit.rationale_quality: Mostly specific and need-driven. The plan lists observable signals first (empty or social website field, active click-to-WhatsApp ads linking to wa.me or Facebook, directory-only presence) and picks sources that expose those signals. Maps shows the website field itself, so it measures the need directly. The Meta Ad Library shows spend with no funnel. Rejections cite this need, not a template: Practo and Lybrate profiles hide phones and are the "listing only" case the buyer excludes. Statutory registers carry no website signal. Associations give names only. Job posts and news have no coverage outside Ahmedabad, and the Reddit/Quora/Facebook-group rejection is backed by a past test of 9 sources. Weak spots: Justdial is justified as "a different frame", yet the plan admits its output has no website field, so it cannot observe the need. It added a directory list, not a signal. The whole verification layer also rests on one scarce shared tool (WebSearch) with no fallback, and that is what failed.
suspicious_candidates: Rank 3 Uma Dental, confidence 'high': the live check was one search that returned only a Latrexa directory page, and its own unknowns say a site under another name is not ruled out. 'High' is not earned.

Rank 4 Geeta Dental and rank 5 Skin Sure: signal_observed says 'WebSearch returned no own-domain site', but the run report says the search returned nothing about the clinic at all. That cannot prove absence of a site.

Ranks 6, 7, 9, 10, 14, 15, 16 (Bliss, Shubham, Mehsana Dental, Shekhat, Vedant, EVA, Prism): 'No web search run' or none that worked. Their 'no website' rests only on the Maps website field. The 'two reads' came from the same actor, so they are not independent, and the plan itself says that field can be wrong.

Rank 17 Shreeji Dental (Dr Shah): it already has a working Flutter single-page site on netlify.app, the content was never read, and it may have a current supplier. It is a weak fit for 'no or very weak online presence' and is correctly low confidence.
Rank 12 Velveta: signal_date is the scrape date 2026-10-26, but the ad started 2025-08-18, so the dated evidence is the 'active' flag, not a fresh event. Also an 'Velvata' vs 'Velveta' name mismatch.

Ranks 18-21 (Aavakar, Sadbhav, Radhe, Ronak) from Justdial: no own-site check at all. Their only phones are Justdial-listed numbers. Justdial often shows its own call-routing numbers, and at least 98452... (Aavakar) looks non-Gujarat; 74116... (Sadbhav) also looks unusual. A pitch might reach a Justdial lead line, not the doctor. Ronak is matched to a Maps 'Ronak Dental' by name only (64 vs 124 reviews) and 111 photos suggests an invested owner who may have a site.
Rank 16 Prism Eye Clinic: Maps category is 'Hospital' and only 43 reviews. It may be a hospital-type entity (an excluded type) and is thin on proof of volume.
Rank 15 EVA: the Maps record and the Justdial record are merged by name and area only. Justdial has no phone, and the newest review is 98 days old.
Rank 8 Rapha Physio: brand-new clinic with a modest budget, no owner name, and the Maps listing has no phone in the data. The phone comes only from the ad.
sources_that_should_have_been_considered: compass/crawler-google-places with website='withoutWebsite' and skipClosedPlaces as the PRIMARY Maps run. It filters for the need on the server and costs about US$0.004 per place. The plan kept it only as a fallback and instead scraped broadly then hand-filtered.

A cheap name-query Maps lookup (scrapesage/google-maps-scraper with category + locality + countryCode 'in' + nameQuery, about US$0.0014 per match, found by the Meta run) as the shared verification step for Justdial and Meta rows. The plan put all verification on the shared WebSearch budget, which ran out, so Justdial rows were never checked.

Website-vendor footprint discovery: search for grexa.site, drxpro, wixsite, business.site, netlify.app and sites.google.com clinic pages in the three cities. The plan lists these hosts only as a filter, but they directly find weak-site clinics and upgrade cases.
Gujarati-language Maps and Ad Library queries from the start (the plan holds them only in the low-yield ladder). Mehsana gave zero clinic ads on English terms.
Recently opened or low-review Maps listings (under 8 reviews). The 8-300 review floor excluded them, and Rapha, the best new-clinic case, was found only through ads.

Re-admitting the Maps rows dropped by the hospital-name regex and the 300-review cap (for example Dr Rajesh Desai Shreeji Dental on a wa.me link, Krishna Dental Naroda), which look like single-doctor practices.
fit.notes:
Verdict: the source choice follows the need. Maps and the Meta Ad Library are the right two, and each was run as a different frame with its own qualifying signal. The first-order selection and rejections show real thinking, not a recipe. Yields: Maps gave 11 clinics, the Ad Library 10 (Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar only, nothing for Mehsana, honestly reported), and Justdial produced a directory list with no proof of the need.

The yield statement is not honest. (1) The plan promised about 5 usable candidates after live verification. The live check mostly did not happen (WebSearch quota gone after about 4 searches; Justdial 403). Even so, the summary says usable_count 21 and enough: true. That counts unverified directory rows (ranks 18-21) and Maps rows with 'no web search run'. By the plan's own standard, only a few candidates are pitch-ready: Amica and Bhavyaa (fresh paid ad, phone matching ad and Maps, empty website field), plus Pramukh and Goradwala, where the weak site was actually opened or curl'd. Uma is plausible but over-rated at 'high'. (2) The 'two independent reads' of the Maps website field came from the same actor and are not independent. (3) A few candidate lines overstate the web check, as noted above. (4) Spend figures are computed from published prices, not billed amounts (the report says so, and the Meta cost is uncertain between 34 and 60 results). The candidate-level 'unknowns' fields are mostly honest, so the problem is the aggregate and the confidence labels, not hidden facts. I did not run any web checks myself; this is judged from the evidence supplied. Recommend: relabel the count to 'about 2-4 verified, about 10 Maps-field-only, 4 unverified directory leads', downgrade rank 3 to medium, and do the live site check as a gate before any outreach.
